Welcome to the Lite Version of Galaxy on Fire 2™.

Starting in the middle of the main quest you can explore two of the over 20 star systems. For this task you are given an already equipped rookie ship.

The Lite Version only features a small fraction of the available ships, weapons, equipment and commodities. Providing OpenFeint / Game Center achievements and leaderboards, the full version also offers a vast galaxy to explore along with a thrilling storyline and animated cutscenes.

Have fun playing!

Control the ship using the virtual joystick or tilt controls. You can change the preferences at any time by opening the pause menu.

Tap Fire to shoot your primary weapons. Double tapping the button will engage auto-fire.

Control the spaceship with the mouse or keyboard. A right click on the mouse switches the mouse on or off, the left mouse button fires the primary weapon.

Press #KEY_SECONDARY to fire rockets and #KEY_BOOST to use the booster.

Control the spaceship with the mouse, keyboard, or gamepad. The left mouse button fires the primary weapon. The middle mouse button switches the mouse between the ship and the operational controls. 

Press the rocket button with the mouse or press #KEY_SECONDARY to fire rockets. Click the booster button with the mouse or press #KEY_BOOST to use the booster.

Extreme

Caution! Extreme mode is intended for experienced players who have already completed the game and are seeking a new challenge. If you select this difficulty level, the following things will change:

- You will have to aim more accurately to hit the target.
- The fuller the hold is, the more difficult it will be to steer the ship.
- Neutral units will become hostile more quickly under fire and your reputation with other factions will sink more quickly.
- You will no longer receive credits for medals.
- The jump drive will cost two energy cells per jump.
- Ore and ore core will no longer be available to buy in the shop.
- Bribes will be higher, wingmen will be more expensive and a 10% security fee will be charged for accepting a mission.
- There will be more pirates and stronger opponents.
- Bombs will cause damage to your own ship if ignited too closely.
- When aborting the ore mining process, you will only receive half of the ore that you have already collected.
- Goods will no longer be available in huge amounts.

The pirates demand #P% of your shipment's value to let you move freely in the system. In your case, that comes to #C. Do you want to pay this amount?
Hey, looks like we got a new customer!
Welcome to Loma! If you want it, we probably have it!
Okay, he's good. Let him through!
You can enter Loma. But don't do anything stupid, okay?
Okay, you asked for it! Get him!
Oh, we got us a deadbeat! Let's show him what we think of that, boys!
We're gonna teach him a lesson he'll never get to remember!!
You should have just paid up when you had the chance!

Maxwell, is that really you? Talk about good timing! We've been under siege from these pirates for days now. They're scaring off business and my buskat supply is running out fast. Could you help an old friend and take care of these guys?
Bravo! I knew you wouldn't leave me in a sticky situation! I'll open the hangar so you can dock, okay?
Ahh, Maxwell! Nice to see you.
That's exactly what I was about to say. What kind of place is this?

Welcome to the Kaamo Club! A place where you can party all-orbit-long or just kick up your tentacles and relax. There's something for everyone here... Oh, what am I saying. There's almost nothing left. Those damn pirates!
This sounds like an opportunity to me!
I urgently need buskat. My girls drank up the entire supply during the siege to calm their nerves. And when customers start coming back I'll be standing here with nothing to offer but M'Kali slime!
Buskat. I think I can manage that. Anything else?

You're keen as ever, Maxwell. I tell you what, let me make you an offer in return. You get me enough buskat, and throw in a few credits more, and I'll give you this station! I've had enough of this neighborhood.
Having my own station would be quite practical for storing goods and stowing a few ships. Sounds good! How much buskat were you thinking of?
50 tons should be enough.
50 tons? Are you trying to fill a swimming pool?

Believe it or not, that's exactly what some Bobolans will pay for. Furthermore, I've spread my tentacles into a number of perviously untouched markets. Squid-forms and Boviniceans alike will lap this stuff up!
Hey, whatever you say. And how many credits do you want on top of that?
Well, seeing as we're such old friends, you can have this, you're very own space station, for a mere 30 million credits.
30 million? Did I hear that right? 30 million credits?
Yes, yes, much too cheap, I know! But like I said, it's a special price for a good friend.
I'll... think about it.
Good. Until you've made a decision, you could take a look in the space lounge. The dealers there have some very interesting offers.
Dock with 50 tons of buskat in the cargo bay and 30 million credits in your account to buy the station from Mkkt Bkkt.
You have enough buskat and credits to buy the station from Mkkt Bkkt. Pay 50 tons of buskat and 30 million credits now?
You can also buy the station immediately by selecting „Expansions" in the main menu. Do you want to jump directly to the menu now?
So, Maxwell, it appears you're really serious about this station, afterall!
The buskat is in the hangar and the credits have been transferred to your account.
Outstanding! If you put your mind to something, you really follow it through. I like that! We should work together more often in the future. I could put your talents to good use!
I may take you up on that. But right now I want to take a look around my new station.
Yes, of course, whatever you like! This is all yours now, afterall. Except for the girls, of course, I'll be taking them with me. We'll meet again, Maxwell!
No doubt about it! Take care old chum!

The Supernova add-on grants you access to brand-new adventures in the Galaxy on Fire universe. You, as Keith T. Maxwell, must prevent a supernova from devastating the entire Mido sector, while fighting to contain a mysterious new enemy. With oodles of new content and an epic storyline, this expansion includes more than 10 hours of action-packed sci-fi gameplay!

Shop

Here's where you've got to buy a weapon and an armor plate for your ship.
In the shop, you see all the ships and items that are available on both the station (left side) and in your cargo hold (right side).

To buy something, tap onto the item of your desire and then onto the button to its right. (The item will then be transferred from the inventory of the station into your cargo hold.) 

To sell something, simply reverse the action: Tap onto the item you want to sell and then onto the button to its left. (The item will then be transferred from your cargo hold into the inventory of the station.)

The better your ship and equipment, the more likely you are to succeed in battle. If you reach a point where you can no longer fight off your enemies, you might want to upgrade your ship and weaponry and then give it another chance.

You have won all the medals! Your actions have earned you fame and notoriety. Many pilots want to be like you, some will even pay you for letting them tag along on your missions. Take these admirers with you next time you are looking for wingmen.
You got all the Gold Medals? Unbelievable! Deep Science will provide you with a prototype of a restored Void fighter spaceship. You can buy it at Thynome.
You also got all the Supernova Medals? Fantastic! As reward you received a new blueprint for fireworks.

Apparently time jumps really do exist. Looks like I'm stranded in the Mido System. I have to get back to Terran territory. Who knows what happened while I was away.

Gunant refered me to his friend Norris Bernard. I should fly to Kernstal to find out if he can help me.

The Midorians lost contact with Yrdal Gedal, one of their space stations. They need someone to fly out there and assess the situation. Norris Bernard promised to help me afterwards, so I'll go check it out.
I met Mkkt Bkkt, the notorious dealer. He's responsible for the incident on Yrdal Gedal. Now I've got to get back to Norris so he can help me return to Terran territory, as promised.

After my time and space jump I need to leave the Mido System and get back to Terran territory.

Norris Bernard should contact me as soon as a Terran convoy crosses this System. Until then I guess I'll try to earn some Credits. I should be able to find work in the Space Lounge.
A Terran convoy is on its way to Kernstal. I need to speak with them. I don't know when my next chance will be to get to Terran territory.
The Voids are attacking our freighters! I've got to help Brent and his men defend the ships.

I met my old acquaintance Brent Snocom. He told me the Deep Science Station still hires experienced pilots. Sounds like a good chance to make some money. I need to meet Thomas Boyle at Suttnar station.
Thomas Boyle has been kidnapped. I have to free him by disabling the kidnapper with EMP bombs. There are some in stock at Kappa station.
I offered Boyle a lift to Thynome Station, where Deep Science is located. I'm on my way there now.

I met Carla. She's certainly better looking than any scientist I ever met before.

She's accompanying me to Sahi where those Void aliens have been sighted. I'll have to salvage their remains, so I'm going to need a tractor beam and a scanner.
What am I doing here? Now I have to fly into a wormhole again and launch a probe to take readings from the Void mother ship. I'd never have agreed to such a dangerous mission if it wasn't for Carla.
I now own a brand new early-warning system to see where the Voids are entering our systems. Now I've got to get back to Thynome for my date with Carla.
This "Khador Drive" would be a nice add-on for my ship. I agreed to gather 50 crystals for Khador, but they can only be obtained in the Void System. Back into the wormhole, I guess.
With Brent's mission taking priority, Keith is forced to miss his date with Carla once again.
I'm supposed to fly to S'kolptorr to talk to a Vossk named Erkkt Uggut, and collect a freighter we'll use to save the galaxy.
So much for our plans. Now Errkt wants me to meet him in the orbit of the planet B'akka. Let's see what he's up to.
Life's never boring in this sector of space. The convoy with the bomb parts has been hijacked by the Mido Confederation. I have to rescue them.
The plan is to escort Errkt through the wormhole to Void Space, and blow up the mother ship using the Deep Science bomb. It's going to be one hell of a firework show. I hope Errkt doesn't mess it up.
I saved the galaxy, Carla has left and I'm on my own again. A good time to go and earn some medals.
Someone on Kanado wants to speak to me about an important matter. I've heard there's good profits to be made there.
With the aid of two allied Vossk, I am now a test pilot for a new Vossk ship. I have to return the ship to Kanado in the Magnetar system.
After the perilous hijacking of the Vossk ship, the boss of this operation wants to speak to me personally. He resides in a hidden system that Cornelius gave me the coordinates for.
My client is a woman called Alice. She wants me to test an automatic turret for her in the neighboring orbit.
Now Alice wants me to get materials for her Liberator missile. I can have the materials shipped to Valkyrie under "Blueprints".

Alice has issues with a few competitors that have flooded the market with cheap merchandise. She wants me to interrupt their shipments. I'll receive 50,000 credits for any freighter that I can destroy with a Liberator. The targets are marked on the map.
Alice seems to be having a bad day. Maybe I'll come see her later.
Carla has contacted me! She is working on the Kothar Station in the Beidan system. I want to see her! Immediately!
Before we can get romantic, I guess I have to rescue Khador. It seems he was kidnapped during a test flight in a distant system.
Supposedly Khador is near Nosdron. I have to help him!
When I mentioned Alice to Carla, she got a little weird. Maybe it's just jealousy. But there could be more to it. I need to find out more about Alice to get to the bottom of this.
Apparently the pirates in the Skavac system have something that belongs to Alice. While Cornelius is on the trail, I am expected to give him cover.

Khador asked me to do a favour for a friend of his. A certain Netor needs a Void essence for his research. It looks as if I have to visit the Voids and drill through to one of these cores before I pay this Netor a visit.
Netor is working on a Disruptor Laser, but apparently it was stolen by his assistent Trot Lykkt. I'm close on his heels.
Trot Lykkt's ship has been destroyed and the Disruptor Laser along with it. I should return to Netor to give him the bad news.
Netor was nice enough to leave me the blueprint for the Disruptor Laser. It seems this project became too risky for his sensibilities.

Alice wants me to intercept a convoy with a secret weapons shipment on board. I should inspect what cargo I find, maybe I'll learn something about her actual plans. The convoy should currently pass the Prospero system.

I'll need an EMP weapon for this mission.

The convoy did not have a weapons cargo. Those were components for the Deep Science research station that Carla and Khador are working on. I should ask Carla what she thinks about this before I confront Alice.
So, Alice is Carla's sister! What kind of family feud did I get myself into? I need to confront Alice. She has certainly something evil in mind.
I have to get out of here! Fast!
I have to stop Alice!
Carla has me back and now Alice has plenty of time to contemplate her misdeeds. It seems everyone got what they deserved in the end.
The Deep Science team is returning to Thynome. I've offered Carla a ride and I'm on my way to Kothar to pick her up.
The Deep Science team is returning to Thynome. I'm taking Carla there.
Something bad has happened. I'm on my way to Valpatro to evacuate ten Midorians. I need sufficient passenger cabins for this task.
The Midorians are on board. Now I've got to dock to the transporter over there and drop the passengers off.
After rescuing the Midorians, Gunant asked me to pay Bargand Surr a visit on Midantha.
I received a gamma shield from Bargand Surr and was asked to help with the evacuations at Luur.
The situation in the Midorian sector seems to be out of control. I'm on my way to Alioth to meet with my old companion, the Terran Security Chief Brent Snocom.
I'm on my way to Genoh to meet the new leader of the Nivelian Republic, Trunt Harval. Let's see if he can give me additional information about the stealth fighters.
Sorry to say so, but I just hate pirates! Anyway, I'm on my way to Katashán, where I've got an appointment with the Nivelian leader Trunt Harval.

Trunt Harval is some pretty strange fellow.
I guess it's best to return to Alioth to report back to Brent.
Another evacuation mission. This time I've been asked to protect a band of dropships at Tadram. Don't ask me why, but I've got a feeling that a repair beam would be quite helpful for this job.

Apparently, the Deep Science team has found a way to reverse the supernova. And guess whose help they need to put their plan into action? But don't worry, good ol' Keith is already on his way to Thynome.
I received the blueprint for an improved gamma shield. I've got to finish it and return to Thynome as soon as possible.
Khador's rocket is ready and I'm the one to fire it into the supernova at Naneroh. I wonder if they're ever gonna give me a danger bonus.
Oh my... I'd better check out what happened.
I should follow the stealth fighter.
Nice work, Khador! The supernova got even bigger after I fired your missile into it. I'd better head back to Thynome so we can figure out what went wrong.
Where the heck is Moonsprocket? Let's see if someone in the Thynome space lounge knows his whereabouts.
Looks like Moonsprocket is on his way to Nepis. I must follow his trail and look for him at the Nepis space lounge.

Wonderful. Now I've got to deal with a drunkard as well. I don't think I'm gonna get any information about Moonsprocket's whereabouts until I've returned to the Nepis space lounge with a bottle of Magnetar Juice.
Next stop: Plural Z space lounge. If Moonsprocket won't be there either, I'm gonna quit and they can try to find another errand boy.
Why the heck do they all want some kinda compensation before they help me out? Well, at least it shouldn't take too long to turn these loan sharks at Marktesh into space dust.
Pirates, loan sharks... they're all alike. I better return to the Plural Z space lounge now and find out where Moonsprocket is.
So Moonsprocket's somewhere in Pescal Inartu system. Good to know. Since I ain't got anything else to do anyway, I'd better go there right away and search the local space lounges.

I finally found him. And guess what, he is totally spaced out. So I better head off to Bak S'ondorr and buy some K'mirrk Toad Mutagen. According to Mkkt Bkkt, the Mutagen will work as an antidote and sober him up.
I must buy the K'mirrk Toad Mutagen at the shop on Bak S'ondorr.

I've bought the K'mirrk Toad Mutagen. Now I just got to return to Moonsprocket on Maissa. Unfortunately, the trip's gonna take a little longer, because with the highly flammable Mutagen on board, it would be suicide to activate the Khador Drive. Jumpgates, here I come!
Thanks to the K'mirrk Frog, Moonsprocket is finally sober again. Now I've got to get him back to Thynome immediately. We've already lost more than enough time.

Moonsprocked believes that the supernova can only be stopped with the aid of four particular prisms. I must go to the Nivelian vaults of Névan. According to Moonsprocket, the prisms are shelved in museum over there.

Great, just great! The prisms were supposed to be sent from Névan to Lopat, but never reached their destination. I must search for clues along the route taken by the freighter that carried the prisms. I should check every orbit with a jumpgate along that route and scan the whole area for the freighter's black box.

I've found the black box. Unfortunately, only one of the four prisms was still floating among the wreckage of the freighter. So I'd better head back to Brent on Alioth. He should be able to decipher the black box and tell me who's been responsible for the raid.

It looks like the wanted criminal Pal Tyyrt is the wire puller behind the attack.

I'd better follow his trail and hunt him down. In order to do so, I must scan every ship that I encounter along the route he's taking. He most likely visits orbits that have jump gates. 

I can check his current travel route in the criminal list on the missions screen.

Pal Tyyrt is responsible for half the crimes in the galaxy but strangely enough he's not the man behind the theft of the prisms. According to him, a Grey by the name of Kehnor has stolen them. So now I'm hunting Kehnor on the Terran wanted boards. I should check his current travel route in the criminal list on the missions screen.
I've finally laid hands on another prism. So now I'm on my way to Var Lupra to deliver the second prism.
I'm on my way to a mining operation on Dekato. The third prism should be there.

Who's told those people that I'm not only an excellent fighter pilot but also a pretty talented asteroid farmer? They said they're only gonna give me the prism if I fly to Coromesk first and help the miners to collect some ores.
I'm on my way to Var Lupra to deliver the third prism.
The last prism is supposed to be in the possession of the Vossk. I'm on my way to B'akrram to meet with my old companion Mekant Orssk.
The last prism is supposed to be in the possession of the Vossk. I'm on my way to B'akrram to meet with my old companion Mekant Orssk.

I never took Mekant for a career soldier, but apparently he's made his way up in the Vossk Empire in the last couple of months. Well, too bad for him that I never cared too much about authorities... anyway, since I've found out that the last prism can be found on a Vossk battleship at Bra'Murr, here's my plan: I must go there with a Vossk ship and a Vossk signature obtained from the black market on Loma. That way I should be able to dock to the battleship and seize the prism. By the time they recognize that it's missing, I'll be long gone.
Wow, that was harder than I thought. But at least I got hold of the last prism. Now I'm on my way to Var Lupra to deliver it to Khador and the rest of the Deep Science team.

Great. Besides the prisms, Khador also requires a certain amount of plasma in order to get the array to work. So I'm on my way to see Gunant on Var Hastra. If there's anyone who can help me with plasma farming, it's him.
Gunant's waiting for me at Kernstal. I must go there with a spectral filter, a plasma collector and at least 15 ionizing missiles equipped.

I've got the blueprint for the needed chromo plasma. Once it's finished, we can bring it to Var Lupra and use it to get the array working.

The midorian border territory is the main gathering zone for the green plasma. The blue plasma can be found near the Aquila system and the purple plasma in the Pescal Inartu area. Red plasma can only be found deep in Vossk territory.
Trunt Harval and a squadron of stealth fighers are launching an attack on the plasma array! I've got to stop this maniac!
Oh no! The plasma array has been destroyed. I should return to Var Lupra and see what can be done.
Now that's an unexpected turn of events. Apparently, the Valkyrie station is a suitable replacement for the destroyed Mido station. So I'd better go to Voids Space and speak to Alice.

Alice said she'd hand over the Valkyrie station in exchange for a cosy apartment... and total immunity.

So all I've gotta do is find her a nice flat on a Terran station that is orbiting a blue planet and has at least a tech level of 5 or higher. I should go to the space lounge of every station that matches these criteria and see if the real estate brokers have such an apartment for sale.
Finally! I've found an apartment for Alice. I'm on my way to Voids Space to tell her the good news.

Oh well... I totally forgot that Alice needs 1000t of energy cells to get the Valkyrie station out of Voids Space. That's a heck of a lot of energy cells. I better ask Brent at Alioth station if they can spare it from Fleet reserves.
The energy cells are on their way to Valkyrie. I should go to Voids space and make sure the deal doesn't go sour.
Damn you, Alice! You almost ruined it. Now I'm gonna bring you to Damarque station, where they will put you away for good.

Let's head back to Var Lupra! The cannon's ready to be fired and I really wouldn't be surprised if Trunt Harval and his minions would show up there as well. It would be a mess if they'd sabotage our operations again.
Trunt Harval will pay for his crimes! I've got to take him down!
Trunt Harval's history... I'd better go back to Thynome now and talk to Carla.
The supernova got stopped, Trunt Harval got blasted into oblivion and I am finally free again. Off to new adventures!

The Terran fleet's most popular fighter. Cheap to manufacture and great looking.

This ship is often used to transport expensive goods or important politicians. It has a large cargo space and can handle itself when it comes to combat.
This Void fighter was immobilized and transported intact to Thynome, where it was modified for human pilots. No information has even been released about what happened to the original pilot.
The heavily armored fighter built by the Vossk Empire. It is available on almost all Vossk stations and has been modified so that other species can pilot it.

Reconstructed Hawk class model. The armour was strengthened and module capacities modified to give this retro vessel no problem keeping pace with newer models. The salesman is justifying the excessive price with this ship's uniqueness.
The Hernstein is a dangerous battleship and is particularly popular with wealthy mercenaries.
This ship was designed as a lightweight rocket ship and is often used by the Nivelian armed forces in large battles. This model has been slightly scaled back for the civilian market.
A popular, customizable Nivelian ship, the Kinzer is equipped with the latest technology and can be personalized with a variety of modules.
The Ward is a powerful Terran-built assault ship. With its four primary weapon brackets and ten module slots, it is the perfect ship for most pilots.
It has little in the way of cargo space, but the Hatsuyuki is agile, heavily armed and very customizable. A masterpiece of Nivelian engineering.

The Nuyang II is an impressive ship. It is armed to the teeth, heavily armored and has plenty of room for cargo and modules. If you are looking for a Mido ship and you have the Credits, there is no better option.
A good all-rounder. Solid, small and perfect for light reconnaissance missions or a weekend getaway.

The Aegir is the Nivelian's flagship vessel. It is perfection, elegance and power all rolled into one. It is not a cheap ship by any means, but is highly sought after by a lot of pilots across the galaxy.
The Groza may not look like much, but it is a well-equipped and very dangerous ship. The large cargo space makes it a common choice among trigger-happy traders.
The Azov is essentially a "Groza Lite". Lighter, more agile, but also less dangerous and smaller than its big brother. It is still a very popular ship for mercenaries and pirates.
A dangerous pirate assault ship. It has heavy weapons, space for a gun turret and a lot of open module bays, making this ship a serious threat to all travelers.
A favorite with mercenaries, this ship is often used to give support to other attack vehicles.
A relatively old Terran design, this ship is average in all respects, but some regard it as a classic.
Like the Hera, the Taipan is more of a vintage offering than a practical choice. The ability to attach three primary weapons gives it a slight edge, however.

Few pilots will ever get the chance to climb into the cockpit of a Veteran due to its prohibitive price. The expense is completely justified by the myriad arming and customization possibilities it offers.
The Mantis is one of the largest and most dangerous ships on the market. Weapons, armor, modules - everything has been maxed out for this model. Only one ship per person please!

After the Mido rebellion, the Berger firm saw a good business opportunity and unleashed the Berger Cross XT on the Mido System's open market. A balanced battle ship for a small budget, the ship sold well and a successor is already in the pipeline.
Originally designed as a research vessel, the Salvéhn has been modified for the military. Officially this ship is still a secret and you can make a lot of money selling one around here.
An extremely agile, small vessel for reconnaissance missions or to get from A to B in a hurry. It is not suitable for combat operations, however, due to its small module slots.
A light, basic Terran ship, made more appealing by the possibility of installing a turret.
The Razor 6 is the successor to the old Terran ship, the Zephyr. It has a greater emphasis on agility and weaponry, and there is only one cheaper ship with four mountable weapon brackets.
A flexible, small missile ship. Perfect for singletons with low expectations and who like to travel often.
The Cormorant is a very special ship. It has the largest cargo space and exceptionally strong armor. It is not possible to attach primary weapons but the existing gun turret provides ample defense.

The Cronus is an extraordinary object. In contrast to traditional models, it draws its energy from a Perpetuum Mobile. The high asking price is to cover the cost of full-time psychiatric care for the many scientists who lost their minds while developing the ships energy system. This ship includes an integrated Khador drive.

With a compact ship design and reduced cargo bay, the Typhon scores with its outstanding maneuverability. The ship's engines are fed by two perpetual generators that are located in the robust wing sections. This ship includes an integrated Khador drive.

With the S'Kanaar, the Vossk are bringing a heavily gunned battleship on the market, which has enough space for a turret in addition to four primary and two secondary weapons. Extremely heavy armour provides solid protection, although this means reduced maneuverability.

The Nemesis is the crown jewel of the Deep Science engineering arts. Heavily armed, well-protected and stylish, it is the perfect ship for the self-confident pilot with credits to spare. This ship includes an integrated Khador drive.

At first glance, the features of the K'Suukk may seem similar to those of the H'Soc, but the improvements are in the details. In addition to stronger armour, the ship has space for an additional primary weapon and plenty of free module spaces.

As a recon ship from one of the ancient Grey fleets, the Vol Noor has almost become a relic by now. At the beginning of the Vossk wars, the timeless design was still in common use, but the increasing demand for increased module spaces eventually made this model obsolete.
Originally a Nivellian creation, the Wraith fighter has, in spite of its age, an excellent balance. Its high agility and its four primary weapon slots are worth noting.
The Specter is a flexible, extremely dangerous interceptor used by the Trunt Harval's black guard. It has a surprisingly large amount of equipment slots and a preinstalled U'tool cloaking device.

The flying fortress of the wanted criminal Qyrr Myfft is the titanium-plated dream of every fighter pilot. With extremely powerful weapons, lots of cargo space, above-average armor and a turret pod, it is a true colossus of a vessel and one of the most destructive vessels in the entire galaxy!

Sh'gaal means "scar" and refers to something every true Vossk is born with. The weapon's name is thanks to the famous warrior Zrrot Grykk who was exiled on Narsaxa. He managed to regain the favor of his leader, which he had previously lost after making inappropriate advances.

The H'nookk is one of the Vossk's deadliest blasters. It consumes so much energy that the old H'Soc fighter had to be rebuilt because all Vossk warriors wanted to equip their ships with this weapon. That was before the Terran Hervarar series hit the market, which offers greater power with less energy consumption.
EMP weapons disrupt the electrical integrity of a vessel, causing the various systems to fail completely. The Luna Blaster is a weak but fast firing weapon, which should be in every armory.

The Sol Blaster is a more expensive version of the Luna Blaster. In issue 693 of Fire and Forget magazine, the Sol Blaster only scored 58 out of 100 in its hardware review. The reviewer suggested buyers would be better saving their money and putting it toward the more expensive Dia EMP Mk III.

This weapon was created out of necessity after violent attacks on traders became increasingly common. The company GalacticArms saw a good business opportunity and developed a powerful EMP weapon, which was then seized by pirates. The upside is that pirate raids on dealers tend to be less dangerous these days as trader ships are usually only paralyzed, rather than damaged.
Terran engineers are responsible for bringing the amazing Hervarar series of weapons to market. The Gram Blaster is deadly, easy to use and looks damn good.
The Ridil Blaster comes from the famous Hervarar series and is the faster version of the Gram Blaster. It's less powerful but has a slightly faster firing rate.
This weapon is the pinnacle of the Hervarar series - almost as deadly as the Gram Blaster, but much faster. In the wrong hands, this weapon poses an enormous threat.
Even 2000 years after their invention, ballistic weapons still haven't disappeared from the scene. The Micro Guns from this category of weapon are very good value.
Even 2000 years after their invention, ballistic weapons still haven't disappeared from the scene. The Micro Guns from this category of weapon are very good value.
This weapon uses a 64MJ reactor to generate lightening clouds so fast that they still contain most of their energy when they connect with their target.

The 128MJ Multirail was the first weapon in nearly 200 years to be withdrawn from the market and have its production ceased by the manufacturer. The recall was instigated due to the high instability of the weapon, which was prone to causing unpredictable, devastating explosions. Clever inventors have succeeded in recreating the weapon from materials that are relatively easy to procure.

The Scram Cannon is one of the fastest firing guns in the market. The technology is so simple that anyone could build one of these weapons from scratch, but it is still preferable to get an original design, handmade by droids.

Alongside Thermo-weapons, the Mass Driver MD 10 has the fastest rate of fire on the market. Unfortunately, its production requires vast quantities of resources, so the weapon is increasingly rare and a popular target for thieves, who steal them from unattended ships.

Thermal Fusion weapons are the latest craze. Some describe them as confetti spinners, others swear by them and never leave dock without them. The o5 is the basic model, so anyone interested in Thermal Fusion can find out if they can handle these powerful weapons.

The big brother of the Thermic o5 supposedly has solar particles from the Weymire System installed within it, giving it slightly increased power. Doubters claim these apparently expensive particles are actually produced very cheaply in the lab, which naturally reduces the weapon's value.

Only the MaxHeat contains the essences of sun particles from 12 different systems. Their special composition is triggered with electrical stimulation to unleash a continuous chain reaction, allowing for an unprecedented rate of fire.

Missiles are not very common among the Vossk, although some have been developed for sale to other races, including the unguided G'liissk. The price is almost on a par with a Golden Octopus cocktail, so it is worth careful consideration before going out drinking if the money would be better spent on a complement of G'liissk missiles.
Missiles, which have no guidance system, are better used at close range. The jet version is cheap and powerful and always worth having on-board for emergencies.

Behind the charming name lies a deadly missile, which wreaks destructive havoc while simultaneously attacking the electronics of its target. This characteristic makes it an unpredictable but interesting part of any arsenal.
A rocket that was built to bring down enemy targets. Because of its speed, it causes additional damage to all nearby targets and should be used carefully.

Missiles follow their trajectory until they hit a target or run out of fuel. The Edo guided missile is similar to the unguided Jet Rocket, though somewhat slower.

The Intelli Jet rocket is as intelligent as you would expect, given its name. It is incredibly fast, has automatic target tracking and causes major hull and EMP damage. It is also very easy to produce, though fortunately this is not common knowledge, otherwise the galaxy would be a much more dangerous place.

S'koonn on Vossk means something like 'fist', though that barely applies to the strange Vossk anatomy. The S'koonn is not necessarily fast, but when it hits, you'll be sorry you ever made any jokes about the Vossk.

A guided missile, which only attacks the electronics of its target. Just before impact, the missile creates an inverse thrust that prevents any direct contact or physical damage to the hull of the target ship before detonating its EMP.

The DEPHASE guided missile causes heavy damage and has the additional effect of generating an electromagnetic pulse that disables its target. The DEPHASE rocket is expensive, cramming two decades-worth of technological achievements into a beautiful shell. So beautiful in fact, that it is used by some wealthy weapons manufacturers to decorate their lobbies.

When EMP blasters and missiles are too weak, or the enemies too numerous, grab the EMP GL bomb. When detonated, the EMP GL causes electromagnetic damage across a considerable blast radius. This type of weapon comes in three variants, with the DX version being the most advanced.

After AMR was almost bankrupted by its poorly received range of digital watches, the entrepreneurs decided to turn their attention to weapons of mass destruction. It turned out to be a lucrative move and the AMR Tormentor is a must for beginners in the field.

The AMR Oppressor bomb is capable of delivering devastating damage. Set this off near a Space Lounge and expect to shatter several cocktail glasses (but don't expect to be allowed in for post battle drinks afterwards).

An atomic projectile with the power to affect the gravitational pull of an entire planet at the push of a button. The company was keen for the AMR Extinctor to be a big seller, but production was ceased after it was banned for being in direct contravention of laws concerning interstellar rules of engagement. Blueprints for the weapon can still be obtained on the black market, if you can afford the high price tag.
A rather slow turret, but if you are looking for comprehensive defense on a budget, you should definitely consider buying the smallest of the Hammerhead series.
An expanded version of the Hammerhead D1 with twin guns, a faster rate of fire and an increased rotational speed. Guaranteed to make any gun nut's heart pound with excitement.

Originally developed as a defensive tower for space stations and K'Sarr freighters, the Vossk quickly realized that other races were interested in this turret. In many raids on Vossk transporters, L'ksaar towers were dismantled in the middle of the battle and stolen. This eventually prompted the Vossk Empire to sell the weapon to the Terran and Nivelian systems.
The Targe Shield was actually designed for personal protection. With some modifications, however, it is capable of protecting an entire ship, though not particularly effectively.

The advertising department did a sterling job of selling the Riot Shield. One ad showed a Nivelian school shuttle being ambushed by pirates. Thanks to the Riot Shield they escape unharmed, and are reunited with their anxious parents.

H'Belam means "father" and describes a powerful Vossk shield that was released for sale to all races.The Vossk themselves tend to prefer stronger armor than the H'Belam, however, which cannot compete with the top models on the market.
A high tensile composition and an excellent regeneration rate make this shield a very popular piece of kit. No wonder at that price.

Anti-matter shields have been under development for some time, but have only recently become commercially available due to a major breakthrough in stabilization technology. The inventors did not get to enjoy their success for long, as the blueprints were stolen a few days after the discovery was made. There are rumors that a network of black market traders are currently trying to get rich by selling the plans.
Armor plating protects the ship against all types of weapons fire and asteroids. But this technology is rapidly becoming obsolete, and compared to shields the E2 Exoclad offers little protection.
This armor is for pilots who want the best possible value for money. Offers adequate protection for most combat situations.

The use of hardened DX particles from ancient asteroids is responsible for the E6 armor's special resilience. The cost of this type of armor plummeted a few years ago when a technique for creating the DX particles under lab conditions was discovered.

Vossk-armor is considered the best of its kind in the known Universe and no other race has managed to successfully reproduce it. The D'iol armor is being used more and more often by engineers in the Terran fleet.

An ultra-hard armor from the Vossk elite production. This armor is the pride of Vossk industry and provides the strongest protection in the galactic market today. T'yol means "forehead", not to be confused with T'yool, which refers to the Vossk sex organs. This mix up has been the undoing of many an unfortunate trader.

This Saber Mine from AMR was once a very popular ordinance, but has since become less appealing in the face of inexpensive automatic turrets. Nonetheless, many travelers always have a batch of Sabers on board, just to be safe.

This practical mine is capable of disabling ships in pursuit. It works by hitting all ships in the direct vicinity with an EMP wave. A pack of pirate ships in tight formation can be rendered immobile with just one precise strike.

For all those who want more kick to their ordinance, there is the Ksann'k. These mines cause serious damage and should only be deployed at a distance of several kilometers from a station or friendly traffic.
The ZMI Optistore packs the cargo using standard ZMI-compression, which is also used for data compression.

This module is for computerized optimization of the available cargo space, so that pilots can arrange their cargo as efficiently as possible. This method is more effective than the ZMI method, as early versions of that product were prone to destroying some goods.

This compression product works by dematerializing cargo at the molecular level. The skillful arranging of pairs of molecules produces quite a lot of extra space, but it can also lead to dangerous mutations. To prevent this happening, each Ultra Compact is equipped with a test module, which traps the more dangerous molecular arrangements.

The Shrinker BT reduces the size of non-organic goods and can save significant cargo hold space. Very few malfunctions have ever been reported, though the story of dealer Tulant Kheont is well known after he was unable to re-enlarge his shrunken explosive charges, and subsequently sold the miniatures as New Year's Day celebration fireworks at Himo. Apparently he made far more money selling the miniatures than he would have done selling common explosive charges.

By creating a stable black hole, the cargo can be sent into an unknown dimension and then retrieved when needed. There have been unconfirmed claims by some space travelers that occasionally some goods fail to return, and that strange artifacts from other worlds have come back in their place.
Designed by mineralogists and perfected by pirates, the tractor beam offers the ability to pick up objects drifting in space. The Retractor is the slowest variant on the market.
The Glue Gun allows pilots to accelerate the collection speed of drifting objects. It can also be used to transfer cargo from crippled ships to your own, though doing so is completely illegal.
The Kingfisher is the only tractor beam on the market with an integrated process for automatically transferring useful objects to the cargo hold without causing disruption.
Briefly increase your ship's top speed. The Linear Boost is the cheapest booster on the market, but also the least reliable.
Although only slightly better than the Linear Boost, the Cyclotron is a top seller. Its balance between performance, recharge time and affordability has been key to its success.

The Synchrotron Boost is in a different league to its predecessor, the Cyclotron Boost. It accelerates the ship to more than double its normal top speed and is ideal for fast, in-orbit maneuvers or escaping tricky situations.

The Me'al booster is extremely rare, and if you see one on offer you should buy it immediately. It is easily the most powerful booster on the market. The Vossk restrict its sale, perhaps to avoid granting their enemies an advantage.
This repair robot automatically makes in-flight repairs to your ship's armor and hull. Very useful for those who often find themselves in a firefight.
Installing control nozzles improves your ship's maneuverability. The Static Thrust is a basic model, which is reflected in the price.
A medium control nozzle that can be installed to any type of ship for increased maneuverability.
D'ozzt jets come from the Vossk production facilities. They are pre-installed as standard in the H'Soc ship, giving it incredible maneuverability despite its considerable weight.

Mp'zzzm jets were the brainchild of the famous clan leader, Irrkt Yennot, who was sick of losing in a popular pirate shooting game. Thanks to the powerful Mp'zzzm jets, Irrkt was able to reach the pirate's hideout quicker and never lost against his opponents.

This very powerful control nozzle makes even the heaviest ships a breeze to handle. For safety reasons, the Pulsed Plasma Jet is sold with an additional padded headrest. It's also advisable to secure all cargo and avoid carrying live stock while using this upgrade.

Scanners allow pilots to safely detect unknown objects, such as asteroids and other ships. The Telta Quickscan is very slow, however, and does not have support for cargo recognition, making it useless for pirates.
The EcoScan is one of the most widely used scanners on the market. Its popularity is thanks to its reasonable price and support for cargo recognition.
Like its big brother the Ultrascan, the Proscan can lock-on to a target in just under two seconds, saving valuable time.

The Hiroto company specializes in fast scanners with high price tags. The Ultrascan is the only scanner that displays asteroids with a core directly in the radar, making it easy to identify A-class celestial bodies. An essential piece of aparatus for anyone who wants to mine ore professionally.

Named after its inventor, a Grey, the Khador Drive allows interstellar travelers to journey anywhere in the universe. This incredible feat is made possible by the Void crystals ebedded in the device, each of which contains a miniaturized image of the entire universe. The drive replaces the need for jumpgates and makes it possible to travel to the Void realm without the use of a wormhole.

IMT manufactures extremely reliable drilling tools that can be used to mine ore on asteroids. The smallest model is only suitable for a short period of drilling, as it lacks the accuracy needed for deeper excavations.

IMT's successor to the Extract 1.3 was really just a new firmware update, though the company still charged the price of a completely new device. Since there were no real alternatives on the market, the proliferation of version 2.7 was widespread and it quickly developed into an industry standard.

The Vossk brought a mining laser to market some time ago, which they simply called K'yuul, meaning "drilling" in the Vossk tongue. The drill's laser is amazingly accurate, though the constant need for re-calibration reduces the quantity of ore it can mine in any given session.

IMT is the dominant player in laser-based mining equipment and has a wide range of products to suit every possible need. The newly launched version of its successful 4.0X Extract series is the best drill that money can buy.

This drill was designed by the Mido scrap dealer Gunant Breh. It is an incredibly powerful device, and if it ever achieves mass-market adoption, it could potentially end up putting IMT out of business.
Passenger cabins allow for the transport of civilian space travelers, and are a prerequisite for taking on any of the lucrative transport missions.

Stealth generators can hide a ship from prying eyes almost completely. It lasts for a short time and is useful for sneaking up on enemies or quickly escaping dangerous situations. The Sight Suppressor II is an entry level model.

The Vossk U'tool is a very powerful device. Rumor has it that each of them is connected to a central Vossk computer that can disable the unit remotely. Because of the uncertainty over the U'tool's security, the device is not as popular as the Terran-built Sight Suppressor series.
A very efficient stealth generator that is believed to be custom built. Should this device make it into mass-production, space will become a very empty place.

There are still places in the galaxy where there is no drinking water. As unfortunate as this might be, dealers certainly enjoy the trade benefit caused by the need for fresh water in certain systems.
Although most serious diseases have been eradicated over the centuries, the increase in inter-species mating means there are always new infections cropping up that must be dealt with.

Some dealers cannot stop buying space debris, convinced they might find something valuable hidden in the waste. The problem is so widespread there's even a special type of clinical therapy available for combatting the addiction.
Archeology - be it bones, books or cell phones.
The universe is full of interesting animals, such as K'mirkk frogs, Mhura bees or Zepar Kumppa stilts. Most animals can be used or prepared in various ways.
On some planets the boundary between animals and plants is blurred. Some of these specimens fetch an extremely high price on the open market.
Since almost every station is now equipped with contamination shields, the threat posed by drugs is quite low. Many illegal substances are still regularly used in the Space Lounges, however.
There will always be goods that go beyond the typical needs of buyers and considered unnecessary or wasteful by the majority of customers.

Neuro-algae Apocce, Zepar honey or eggs of the rare S'iik beetle are foods that only some people can afford. Whether they are actually more palatable than less exotic food is purely a matter of taste.

For today's nutrition, almost all foods are created in laboratories, packed with flavor, vitamins and are prepared in a visually appealing way. Naturally produced foods are usually only eaten on special occasions.
There are also synthetic organs available on the market but real ones are cheaper most of the time.
Whether you want to cook a tasty dish, or study them for research purposes, Vossk organs aren't readily available and you will usually have to search long and hard for them.

Buskat is the remnant of an imploded star and therefore extremely rare and expensive. The wives of various luxury obsessed dictators, known for their extravagance, often use it on special occasions as a spice or narcotic.
A statue with a familiar face. Everyone should have one of these figures.

The AMR company produced these watches as part of a retro trend. They ended up being one of the company's biggest commercial flops of the last 500 years. The watches were not set on stellar unit time, but an outdated 24-hour period used by the Terrans, making them practically useless.

A towel is one of the most useful objects a space traveller can have. You can wrap yourself in it for warmth; use it as a blanket; use it as a sail, a weapon, a mask, a flag, or even just to dry your body.

Jump out of a moving ship without dying, win an arm wrestling match against a Vossk, attract the gaze of a woman at the other end of the bar, or just look good naked. All this is possible with implants.
Good explosives are manufactured by the Nivelian in the Nesla System and are used primarily for mining resources
Important-looking documents that are definitely missing.
A container. It is locked and cannot be opened.
A cabin that was picked up in space. It is closed and has no windows, but you can hear muffled screams.

Electronics today are comprised mainly of quantum and nano components. Even a cocktail glass has nano-electronic sensors built into it, which change the glass's color when its empty so the bartender knows it needs refilling.
Natural and laboratory-made substances that have all sorts of different applications.
The properties of the polymers within the plastic can be varied at will, giving it a wide range of applications.

Tiny particles that remain hidden from the naked eye that can be very useful. For example, there are nanobots that can transport medicine to certain hard-to-reach parts of the body and cure contagious diseases.
These small cells save a tremendous amount of energy that can be released when needed. Energy cells are highly standardized and can be connected to almost any device.
Biomass is an edible substance for sentient beings and animals; it is a renewable raw material and an energy source all rolled into one.
Although no longer classified as extremely hazardous, radioactive goods are still unpopular. Perhaps it is the yellow symbol or the strong lights that make people associate them with danger?
Screws, chains, gears, gaskets and everything that is used for power transmission or coupling.
Non-flammable, non-water based and virtually colorless and odorless. For inert gases, there are a variety of applications.

Following the discovery of the smallest particles in the universe, microchips have shrunk enormously. If you buy a load of microchips, consider using a hadron microscope to check they are all there before paying.
A transceiver for all different ranges, frequency modulations, critical system cabless and more.
Optical components for data transmission, wide-range scanners, implants, medical applications and many other uses.
The hydraulic was perfected over a thousand years ago and has since been reduced to the nano scale. They're still useful for various applications and relatively inexpensive to produce.
Organic and inorganic remains of a Void ship. It looks as strange as it smells.

As a response to the increasing number of pirate attacks, a new type of weapon was developed that is especially well-suited to eliminate smaller groups of opponents while also presenting an inexpensive alternative to bombs. The projectiles have an approach sensor that ignites an explosive charge of plasma when activated.

Having already demonstrated its competitiveness in the laser industry, the Berger company has now developed a FlaK weapon superior to the Nirai model, thereby harking back to their milleniums-old family tradition. The name of this weapon is a tribute to the excellent craftsmanship of the Berger ancestors.

When this weapon's destructive potential became apparent on the field of battle, a law was created to prohibit its civil and military use. Since then, its deployment has violated all war conventions. Although nearly all stockpiles were destroyed in compliance, a few arms traders managed to steal the blueprint.
This deadly missile can be remotely controlled after being fired. The Liberator is extremely fast and maneuverable and therefore an ideal weapon to destroy groups of opponents from a large distance.

The Berger Group released this automatic turret on the market several decades ago, and it is still produced today. Although much more effective models are available, this weapon's affordable price and efficient design continue to be the decisive factors for its lasting success.

If you see a ship with a mounted Skuld twin gun, you can assume that the owner does not belong to the official armies of this galaxy. For the rather high price, you receive an excellent performance and can handle intense engagements with ease.

The Archimedes is a faithful guardian system which will mercilessly fire on anything classified as hostile by the radar. Due to constant upgrades in the market, the turret is in perpetual development. However, it has been possible to buy leaked blueprints on the black market for some time.

The high effectiveness of the Disruptor Laser can be attributed to the use of artificially grown crystals that have a high optical density. The expensive lens is designed to achieve a wave length of exactly 438.511nm, which corresponds to the resonance frequency of modern shield systems and therefore destabilizes them.

Known for their paradox developments, the Rhoda company has launched another incredible product on the market. During quantum radiation, a secretion extracted from the saliva of the Prosperian protofly generates a dilation field that slows down time for the user.

This emergency system creates a temporary, impenetrable shield around the ship as soon as it reaches a critical level of damage. After the activation, the module becomes unusable and has to be bought again. The Galactic Tourist Agency is considering the introduction of a law that obligates all cruise ship companies to install these on their vessels.

Thanks to improved barrel cooling, this tuning module increases the firing rate of all installed primary weapons. However, the high energy expenditure leads to a reduction in the weapons damage effectiveness.
This module ensures that a greater amount of energy is charged between the individual shots from the primary weapons. This results in greater weapons damage at the expense of a lower firing rate.

A major breakthrough in Artificial Intelligence research now makes it possible for robots to feel love. This repairbot is programmed to "fall in love" with its ship during installation, giving an exceptional boost to its care and efficiency in maintenance and repair tasks.

Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the SpaceNet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot. Data privacy experts are critical towards their application and warn against abuse. Spies can take advantage of this security gap to act behind enemy lines without revealing their identity. Fortunately a signature becomes unusable as soon as someone has been uncovered due to misconduct.

During the development of SunFire o50, the hydrogen reactions observed in the photosphere of stars was used as a model. Through the temporary creation of an extremely strong magnetic field, the resulting electromagnetic radiation can be bundled into enormous kinetic energy. In other words: This weapon is hot!
In contrast to its predecessor, this tractor beam can collect freight at an angle of 360°. Forgot to close the door to the cargo bay again? No problem.

Many test pilots were sacrificed for the development of this powerful booster. Before a G-force compensator was added as counter-measure, a number of volunteers were pressed flat by the enormous acceleration force. Despite protests, the researchers quite literally sweep the matter under the carpet.

Originally, plasma filters were used for the observation of the spontaneous methane emissions of metabolic life forms. Soon after, however, they were also used for the detection of rare gas clouds. The filter's false color rendering is based on the fact that intergalactic gas clouds have a higher optical density than the vacuum that surrounds them.
Ionization missiles are used to bundle gas into plasma orbs, which can be collected and isolated with the aid of plasma extractors.

The basic model of a plasma collector. Since its proton-alignment mechanisms are no longer up-to-date, the rotation speed of the Proton is comparatively slow. Though it's not one of the best devices on the market, it's still suitable for most purposes.
Due to its wider range and higher rotation speed, the Ambipolar-5 is more powerful that the Proton. The absorption speed of the plasma orbs is a bit slower though.
This collector makes use of enriched hydrogen-atoms for the stimulation of the plasma orbs. This process results in a particularly wide range.
A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its green glimmer. Can be harvested in the midorian border territory.
A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its blue glimmer. Can be found between Aquila and Prospero.
A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its purple glimmer. Can be found near Pescal Inartu.
A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its red glimmer. It is very unstable and likely to explode if exposed to concussion. Can only be found deep in Vossk territory.
A basic means of protection against high gamma radiation. This shield is mostly used in the research of solar activities.
The Gamma Shield II offers better protection against high levels of gamma radiation than its predecessor. This shield is currently being tested by Deep Science.
A civilian repair-laser, which is particularly popular among traders and merchants. Since its operation range is rather limited, you have to be close to the objects you're about to repair.

The SPP-M50 has been developed by the Terran Navy. The device was only made available for civilian use upon completion of the M200. Hence it is the strongest freely available repair beam on the market.

This particularly nasty substance is extracted from the poison glands of the giant K'mirkk Frog. It is very rare and hard to obtain for several reasons. On the one hand, its extraction is very difficult due to the K'mirkk Frog's heavy carapace and on the other hand, its transport is extremely dangerous, because the substance is likely to explode if it is subject to repeated concussions.

Chromo plasma is won by mingling and compacting four different sorts of plasma. This substance is particularly valuable because of its extremely high energy level. Since it is also prone to magnetic deviation, it can only be stored in containers with a special kind of sodil-alloy.

Outstanding. I'll be unconscious any moment. Exactly... What... I... Needed...
zzz... zzz... zzz...

What a beautiful old ship! And it seems to be intact.
Wait a minute. I'm reading a life form signature.
Another good reason to take it home for closer examination.
Ohhh... What happened?
Ah, finally awake. But I'm afraid you'll have to tell me what happened.
Where am I? Who are you?
Take it easy. You're on Var Hastra Mining Station. My name is Gunant Breh.
Var Hastra? I've never heard of it. What happened to my ship?
The whole propulsion system is beyond repair. Seems like you had quite a party out there.
Damn. Now what am I gonna do without a ship?
Hey, I'm a busy ore trader. If you work for me maybe we can figure something out that'll benefit us both.
You're just lucky the Voids didn't pick you up, floating in space.
The Voids? Who are the Voids?
You haven't heard of them? Where are you from, boy?
These creatures are raiding the Mido System more and more.
Mido system? What are you talking about? I've never heard of that either. I was trying to get to Eden Prime!
Eden Prime? Ha! You're funny! That's the other end of the galaxy. I guess you'll need to work for me for a while, if you're trying to buy passage all the way to Eden Prime.
Ore trader, eh? More like scrap-collecting extortionist.
It's up to you. Either you help me out with the ore-mining or you can go back to floating in space. It's that simple. I can't afford to feed you for nothing.
A ship with a mining laser is already waiting for you. Without weapons, of course, in case you get any ideas. Now get to work. You've been lying around long enough.
Seems like I've no other choice, toad face.

Done already? I guess you're not completely useless after all. Dock at the station, so I can check the load.
Dammit! Without any weapons I've no other choice than to accept Gunant's rules.

Choose Var Hastra as your destination. Your ship will then automatically take course for that station and dock to its hangar. 

If you want to steer your ship manually, you can abort the autopilot by tapping the respective button a second time. 

Alternatively, you can take the station into your crosshairs just like an asteroid and press the fire button as soon as its locked. This will activate the autopilot, too.

You can accelerate the docking process by tapping the fast forward button in the shape of a double-arrow. This option is only valid if there are no hostile ships (red dots) in the orbit.

Press #KEY_AUTOPILOT or the Autopilot button on the left side of the screen to activate the autopilot, and select Var Hastra station. Your ship will set a course and dock at the station automatically. Tap the button again at any time to deactivate the autopilot. 

You can also target lock a station just like an asteroid, and press #KEY_DOCK to engage the autopilot.

Click the autopilot-button on the left side of the screen or press #KEY_AUTOPILOT to access the list of possible autopilot targets. Select Var Hastra station. The list will close, and your ship will set a course and dock at the station automatically. To deactivate the autopilot, tap the button again or press (#KEY_AUTOPILOT).

Welcome back! That wasn't so bad. Now I need you to go back, and bring me a full cargo load of ore this time.
Again? You ungrateful son of a...
Careful, boy. I'm the one giving the orders. If you get the job done I might even let Betty keep you.
Wow. That'd be a dream come true.
Oh, a comedian as well, eh? Get out of here!
You know how it works now.
Oh, great. There's a pirate approaching and I'm unarmed!
Hurry, boy! Get back to the station! Activate the autopilot!
You made it! These pirates are a real pest sometimes. I don't risk leaving the dock when they're around.
Getting nervous, eh? Give me some weapons, and I'll teach them a few manners.
Hey, it's not my job to talk you out of a suicide run. But if you want to go and get rid of their hideout, that'd help me a lot. Their raids are becoming more and more frequent.
Sounds better than mining asteroids.
Great! I'll grant you access to the hangar. Go and get yourself a weapon and some armor plating. I'm gonna prepare my ship, too. Let's see if you know how to fight.

Enter the hangar by tapping the hangar button on the lefthand side of the screen. 

Once you're there, the first thing you're recommended to buy is a weapon and a shield. 

As soon as you've got them, enter the ship menu and mount them to your craft. 

The tech level of a station indicates the quality of the items that are sold in its hangar.
Good choice. Let's get moving. And by the way, I've programmed your weapons so they can't penetrate my shields. Just a precaution, you understand.
Listen up, boy! The waypoints lead us to the pirates' hideout. Better stay right behind me.

Admiral Smith? That's a long time ago. You don't look that old.

Let's just get back to the station.

Yeah, I'm sure he would. He still owes me money for the last assignment. I was just on my way to see him before you found me.
Hmm, good luck trying to get money from a dead man.
Dead?
Yes, dead. Died of old age. Everyone's number comes up eventually.
What? When did he die?
Some years ago, now. 3612 I think.
3612? That can't be! What year is it now?
You're a strange one, all right. It's 3624 by the Terran calendar, and from the looks of things it's going to be the year of the Voids.
Keith is stunned to discover 35 years have passed since the incident in the asteroid belt.
Gunant checked Keith's ship, and a malfunction in the hyperdrive engine was most likely the cause for Keith's journey through time and space.
He shows Keith his gratitude to defeating the pirates by giving him Betty as a gift; now equipped with a more powerful drive, allowing him to travel to other planets within the same star system.
As promised, Betty is yours. Take good care of her!
Well, she needs a bit of work, that's for sure. Anyway thanks for your help.

Just one thing. The mining laser you've been using is a prototype I built myself, the only one of its kind. I can't give it to you. But I installed another one. With a little practice you'll be able to make a few Credits mining asteroids on your journey.
Thanks. And you can call me Keith. Keith T. Maxwell.

My pleasure, Keith. One more thing. A friend of mine, Norris Bernard, is the Commander of Kernstal, also a station of the Mido Confederation. Why don't you pay him a visit? He might be able to help you to get to Eden Prime.
That's a good place to start, thanks Gunant. But what is this Mido Confederation exactly?
This entire system is Mido territory. Perhaps you'd better ask Norris. He can tell you more about it. Good luck, boy... I mean Keith.

Fly to Kernstal and meet Norris Bernard. 

Open the map by tapping onto the map button in the lower left part of the screen. 

Use the map to travel the universe and set course for other stations.

You can check your current tasks and missions in the missions menu.
Keith T. Maxwell? I'm Captain Bernard, commander of Kernstal. It's a pleasure to meet you. Gunant told me what happened. You must be pretty confused right now.
You're not kidding. Jumping through time and space, that's something. Tell me about the Mido Confederation. I've never heard of it.

Well, you have missed a lot in the past 35 years. The Mido System is located in a sector of the galaxy that's only recently been discovered. We retreated here at the beginning of the Nivelian Civil War when the Mido Confederation of Planets was founded. We try to avoid contact with other Systems as much as possible.
So Mido is a confederation of Terran and Nivelian rebels and outlaws, founded during the Nivelian Civil War?

You could say that. We declared our independence, which the Terrans accepted, but the Nivelians still claim Mido as their territory. That's why there are still conflicts in the outer reaches of the system.
I see. Gunant told me you might be able to help me get back to Terran territory.
I could arrange that. But in return I'd like to ask you for a favor.
Which is?
It could be risky. We lost contact with Yrdal Gedal, one of our space stations. They could just be having problems with their communication system, but we need someone to fly out there and check.
So it could also be the Nivelians, pirates or something else that's behind it, right?
That's why we need someone who's willing to take the risk. An experienced fighter pilot like you. Just don't go getting into any pointless fights.
I'm on my way.
Assuming I'm not completely lost, I should be at the right place. No sign of combat, and the station appears to be intact. I guess I'll dock and take a look around.
Nobody here. Not even Nivelians. Wait...
I don't believe it. Mkkt Bkkt! What the hell are you doing in this godforsaken place?

Have we met before? Ah, Maxwell! Is that you? Long time no see! You're just in time for our little party. I managed to ship in a load of premium neuro-algae from Apocce. The crew here can't get enough of it!
Algae, eh? Sounds interesting. Does this stuff have any unpleasant side effects?
Not really. Some people have reported a bit of tentacle growth, but that's more of a benefit than a side effect.
You mean tentacles on their face?
Yeah! How did you know?
Just a wild guess.
But Keith, you've got to tell me why you still look so young. I know a lot of people who'd be interested in buying whatever it is you're using.
You don't want to know. Tentacle growth is nothing compared to the side effects I'm having.
Okay Mkkt Bkkt! I'll leave you with your new friends. See you around.
Take care. And by the way, you can find me on Kaamo in the Shima system if you ever need something extra special!
Brilliant! Out of all the rogues I could have run into, it had to be Mkkt Bkkt, the most notorious dealer in the galaxy. Neuro-algae! Hardly surprising no one's able to operate the intercom.
Maxwell, good to see you again. What did you find out?
Looks like the crew of Yrdal Gedal is completely wasted, thanks to Mkkt Bkkt.
The dealer? Unbelievable! Is it serious?

I'm sure they'll crawl their way back to normality, eventually. But I suggest you take the crew to a detox center after they're back on their feet. Or maybe a fish tank. Now, can you help me get back to Terran territory?
Yes, of course. A Terran military convoy is heading for Kernstal. That would be your best option.
Sounds good.

I'll contact you again as soon as the convoy reaches the system. In the meantime, feel free to make use of the Space Lounge. You can probably pick up some work there. A good way to pass the time and earn a few extra Credits. And I think I'll go and have a chat with our friend Mkkt Bkkt.

The space lounge is now accessible via the respective button on the left side of the screen. Once you've entered the space lounge, you can accept side missions and meet new contacts there. 

Norris will contact you after you have completed a couple of missions. 

If you don't like the freelance missions offered to you in a particular space lounge, check out other stations and see what they've got in stock for your.
Keith? I have a report that the Terran convoy has entered our system. It's heading for Kernstal now. Good luck!
Thanks, Captain. I guess that's my cue to be leaving. Perhaps we'll meet again some day.
Ah, there's the convoy, and it looks like pirates are closing in on it. I'd better intercept them.
There, another pirate ship! Ready the EMP blaster!
That should take care of them.
Hey, why are you idiots shooting at me! I'm trying to help you!
Surrender! Your ship has been disabled and you're under arrest. Prepare to have your ship impounded.
A prisoner, Keith is taken aboard a cruiser heading for planet Alioth in Terran space.
On Alioth Station, Keith is being interrogated by Lieutenant Commander Brent Snocom.
...and that's why we thought you were a pirate. It's a surprise to see you alive. You were declared dead a long time ago.
As you can see my death was a bit of an exaggeration. A malfunction in my hyperdrive pulled me through time and space.
Incredible. And then you got stranded in the Mido System, eh?
Took me some time to get back on my feet again, I was hoping to get back to Terran territory. Not as a prisoner though.
Sorry for the inconvenience. I can imagine that Mido must have been rough for you. The whole system was only settled a few years ago, and the inhabitants are really struggling to make ends meet.
Brent, since when do you care about rebels and outlaws? I thought you were a security officer?
Well that was some time ago, Keith. Now I'm Lieutenant Commander, Chief of the Interstellar Security Agency. Among other things I'm responsible for...
Alert! Void fighters located in Alioth orbit. All hands to battle stations! All hands to battle stations!
What's happening?
What the... I never expected them to come here, too. I'll explain later. Prepare your ship!
Keith, this is Brent! The Void ships are attacking our freighters. We need to defend them!
All right, I have them on my screen. Let's see what they've got!
ASLDFJK OWUT YVBMASDF WERÖAHJKG ALSDFJASDF LKAJDF ASDLKFJ ASFLKJ ASDFLKJ A WERWER
Interesting way of saying hello.
Another wormhole. They're trying to escape!
Follow them! Don't let them get away!
Too late! They disappeared.
Dammit! They've taken the whole shipment. Another attack like that and we'll have to close down the station.
How long has this been going on?
Let's head back first. I'll give you a full briefing at the station.
...so after that, I had to marry her. The surgery looked great, but eventually I realized...
No offense, Brent, but can you stick to the story please?

Oh, yeah. Sorry. Anyway, you've seen the problem we're dealing with. These Voids are a real pest. They have the technology to open up wormholes and jump anywhere they like. Their tactic is always the same. Hit and run. They jump in through their wormhole, attack freighters, take the cargo and jump back out.
Any idea where they're coming from?
Unfortunately we haven't been able to pinpoint where the wormholes lead.
So you can't detect where or when they're going to attack?
Exactly. They're extremely unpredictable. As head of security I've been placed in command of a crisis team tasked with finding a solution.
Our best scientists are working on countermeasures at the Deep Science research station. If you're interested, they're still hiring experienced pilots. You'd receive adequate compensation.
I could use the money. But babysitting scientists?
Well not quite. For the exact job description you'd better talk to Lieutenant Boyle, a scientist traveling to Deep Science.
Thanks Brent. I'll look him up when I get there.
Without Boyle's navigation data you won't find the system where the station is located. It's top secret, and isn't listed on standard star maps.
That's quite some security you have there. How can I get in touch with him then?
He's expected at Suttnar Station in the Union system before travelling to Deep Science. You should meet him there.
Sounds like a plan. Thanks for your help.
No problem Keith. I'll tell Boyle to expect you. We'll talk later. Bye.
You can travel to neighboring systems by using jumpgates. On the station, use the map to plan your route. In space, set the autopilot to the jumpgate.
Here we are. I hope Boyle's still on board. Keith T. Maxwell to Suttnar Station. Do you read me?
This is space station Suttnar. What can we do for you, Mr. Maxwell?
I'm here on behalf of Commander Snocom. I'm scheduled to meet Lieutenant Thomas Boyle.
Ah yes. Unfortunately Lieutenant Boyle's ship hasn't arrived yet, but I have a message for you from Commander Snocom. He asks that you contact him immediately.
Well, that's a good start. Computer, open a channel to Brent Snocom.

Keith, bad news! I just received a report that Lieutenant Boyle was kidnapped near Kappa. The kidnapper is asking for a five million credit ransom. We have to find a way to save him. Boyle is irreplaceable at Deep Science.
Leave it to me! I'll get tooled up and show them how we deal with kidnappers.
Not so fast Keith. We better stall them while we come up with a real plan. In the meantime, get yourself over to Kappa as fast as possible.
Keith, we're in luck. Kappa Station picked up a signal from the kidnapper and was able to track his ship, so we know where Boyle might be.
Great! Any idea how we can get him out alive?
There is a small reserve of EMP bombs in the Kappa Station hangar. You're going to deliver something different than what they're expecting.
So we're gonna surprise them?
Exactly. You need to dock at the station and mount the EMP bombs on your ship. Be as quick as you can. We can't stall the kidnapper much longer.
That's the EMP bombs installed. I'd better get moving before it's too late.
The kidnapper must be somewhere between the two waypoints. The scanner will tell you if Lieutenant Boyle is on board. Be careful not to destroy his ship. Just disable it.

Open the secondary weapons menu and select the EMP bomb.

The Secondary Fire button will launch the bomb, and tapping it again will detonate it.

Open the secondary weapons menu (#KEY_SECONDARY_WEAPONS) and select the EMP bomb.

The Secondary Fire button (#KEY_SECONDARY) will launch the bomb, and pressing it again will detonate it.

Open the secondary weapons menu by clicking the action menu button and the secondary weapon button, or by pressing (#KEY_SECONDARY_WEAPONS) and select the EMP bomb.

You can launch the bomb by clicking on the rocket button or pressing #KEY_SECONDARY. Pressing it again will detonate it.
Hey, you! What are you doing here? Buzz off before we get really angry!
Hmm, looks like a scout. I bet the kidnapper's hiding at the second waypoint.
If you don't want to listen, find out the hard way! Take him out!
Those idiots! I told them not to let anyone through.
Damn, I've been set up! All systems are down!
Well done, Keith! Head back to the station. We'll send a squad to pick up Boyle.
Thanks for the rescue. I'm Lieutenant Thomas Boyle. You must be Keith T. Maxwell.
That's right. Brent told me you're in need of pilots?
Indeed. Now I've seen you in action, would you be interested in a job? We need experienced pilots for some very, very, very...
...very dangerous missions. Of course the payment will be adequate.
Count me in! Dangerous is my second middle name.
Oh, and what's your first then?
T.
Brent said you'd know the way. I can offer you a lift, as long as you have the navigation data to get us to the Deep Science Station.
