Sure, I know the way. It would be great if you could take me. I'll transfer the coordinates of the Wolf-Reiser System to your navigation computer. Let's get moving. We've lost a lot of time already.
You have received the coordinates to a new star system. You can select it on the star map.
Here we are - finally! Dr. Paolini is expecting us. I already notified her about our arrival.
Thomas! I heard what happened. I'm so glad you're safe. And you must be our new pilot, Mr. Maxwell. Commander Snocom speaks very highly of you. Welcome to Deep Science.
Thanks. Call me Keith.
As you wish, Mr. Maxwell. I'm Dr. Carla Paolini, head of Deep Science. Has Commander Snocom briefed you about the research program and the Voids?
He told me about the Voids, and I've seen them in action already. Aggressive bunch. Now what exactly do you want me to do?

Our first objective is to find out more about their technology. I'd like to capture a Void ship, or at least parts of it to analyze. Deep Science will provide you with 20,000 Credits so that you can equip your ship properly. A tractor beam and a scanner will be required.
Where I'm from, I could have bought a whole ship for 20,000.
Well, times are changing, Mr. Maxwell. As soon as you're ready I'll accompany you to Sahi in the Weymire System. We've recently detected Void activities there.
You want to accompany me on the mission? With all due respect, I think this might be a bit too dangerous. I'd better go alone.
Mr. Maxwell...
Keith, please.
Keith. I need to see the Voids with my own eyes. Theory and reality are two very different things, if you see what I'm saying.
Okay, Carla. You're the boss.

Good. We should leave immediately, or we might miss the Voids. Make room in your cargo bay and don't forget to install a tractor beam and a scanner. You can acquire both in the hangar. Tell me when you're ready to leave.
Yes, ma'am.
Okay, let's go to Sahi.
There they are! Now how do we capture one of their ships?
We don't. We just shoot them and collect the pieces.
At least we'll get some parts of it, I suppose. But get as close to them as possible. I have to see them.
I'm on my way. Take it easy. Just sit back and try to relax.
ASDFASDF KLJLKJTRZLKY LKJASDF WEROIBNIJS DFKJSDLF SLFDKWT
They don't sound too friendly, do they?
I don't think that was a declaration of love, anyway.
Good. I think we have enough samples. We should head back now.
What is this thing? KEITH!
Keith! Where are we? What happened?
Easy, Carla. We just took our first ride through a wormhole. We're no longer at Sahi.
Amazing! This must be their home system. Look at this! Seems to be some sort of mother ship.
Void fighters! We have to get out of here, and the only way out is the way we came in. Through the wormhole.
Are you sure? We have no idea where it'll take us. And look, it's closing!
Damn! There's another one opening. I'll try to get us there before this one closes, too.
We... we're back! It worked. Look out! The Voids are following us!
Persistent bunch. They're starting to get on my nerves.
We have to get rid of them. They mustn't follow us to Thynome.
Excellent work, Keith. Let's get back to Thynome.
You got it. I could use a drink now anyway.
Good to be back. I need to get to work and analyze the Void remains immediately.
All right. If you need me I'll be in the lounge, with a couple of drinks.
Two days later...
Keith! You have to get back to the Voids' system as soon as possible!
What? You want me to go back? We barely made it out alive last time!
Please, Keith! Now that we know how to get to their home world, we must take advantage of it. My team has just developed a probe that can analyze the mother ship.
And I have to deliver it, right? Not exactly a pleasure cruise. Unless you care to join me again?

Sorry, not this time. My team and I still have to finish analyzing the remains we collected. This time you should get to the Pescal Inartu System as soon as possible. We just received a report of Void activity there. This is your chance to locate another wormhole.
Okay, on one condition. If I make it back alive you owe me a date.
A small price for saving the galaxy, I suppose. Agreed.
You've got a deal!
Here they come. I have to get to the wormhole before it collapses.
LKJWOIZUT SKJHFBXCV KJSDF WRIUZ XMBNSDF JKHTPO
Yeah, yeah. I heard you the last time.
Time to launch the probe. Carla designed it to launch automatically, as long as I can get a target lock on the mother ship.
Probe launched...
Now I just need to stay alive long enough to receive its data transmission.
Three minutes and counting...
Okay, let's try and stay out of trouble for a while.
SDFLK WEHB XLSDK SDKH SDFLS
I have a feeling I'm not too welcome here.
Done! Data transfer complete. Time to get back through the next wormhole.
Computer! Open a channel to Dr. Paolini.
Keith! Good to hear from you. What's your status?
Mission accomplished. Piece of cake. You can get dressed for our date now.

Great job! But before you get back to Deep Science, I need you to make a detour through the Augmenta System and meet Brent at Alioth Station. He has some news for you. Transmit the probe's data from there.
Fantastic. I'll make it quick. Don't forget about our date!
Keith! Good to see you. How do you like Deep Science? Dr. Paolini told me that you've become quite important to her.
Oh really?
Yeah, sure! Your skills as a fighter pilot are highly regarded.
Oh, fighter pilot, yeah. Well, I try to be useful, you know. Can we do this quickly? I have an appointment.

Sure. Look, I've contacted you because we've made a huge breakthrough in dealing with the Void attacks. We've developed an early warning system that integrates into the star map. It allows us to determine the exact location of where the Voids are about to generate a wormhole. With a few modifications to your navigation computer you should be able to receive the signal.
Nice! Good to know which planets I should avoid.
Actually I was hoping you'd use the warning system to find out where the local forces need a bit of backup.
I knew you were going to say that.
Hey, you're free to do whatever you think is right. I transferred 30,000 Credits to your account for what you have already done for us. Does that cheer you up?
That's a start, Brent! See you around!
Thynome. It's becoming my second home. Never thought I'd have much fun around boring scientists. Now let's see how that date with Carla will turn out.
Ah, Mr. Maxwell. Welcome. My name is Khador. Finally I get a chance to meet you. I hope it's not inconvenient, but I assure you my business is quite essential.
I'm sure it is, Khador.

Mr. Maxwell, while examining the data of the probe, I concluded that the secret behind the Voids' intergalactic transport system is the molecular composition of unique crystalline elements they use in creating the wormholes.
Okay...

The data from your last mission suggests that such crystals are to be found solely in Void territory. I kindly request you travel there and provide me with at least fifty tons of these crystals. If your cargo hold isn't big enough, you may have to buy another ship to complete this task. And do not forget to equip a mining drill.
Maybe later, but first I really need to see Dr. Paolini.
Erm, Dr. Paolini is extremely busy at the moment. She can't see you.
What? Why can't she see me?
As I was saying, I'm working on the development of a new spaceship engine that would make it possible to travel instantly to any location in space. Much more efficient than the current jumpgates.
It will have a lasting effect on our society. I believe I shall call it the Khador Drive. But first I need those crystals. They're just what I have been looking for all these years.

I could certainly use a drive like that. Since Carla is otherwise occupied, I'll look into getting these crystals for you. Brent's early warning system will locate the Void wormholes on the star map, so at least I'll know where to jump into the shark tank.

Mr. Maxwell! You are back, and you have my crystals! I believe I am experiencing what you humans call excitement! Here's a copy of the Khador Drive's blueprint, and a prototype I've already begun assembling. Use the blueprint to complete the drive's construction, and you'll be able to travel as far as the Voids' home world, should you wish to do so.
Fantastic! Thanks Khador. Always a pleasure doing business with you. I...
Carla! This must be my lucky day. How about that drink now?
Ah, Keith! Sorry, I've been busy analyzing the data. There's something important I have to tell you.
Let me guess. You're cancelling our date?
Sorry, Keith, I'm much too busy.
Sounds like you could use a bit of Keith time.

Let's talk about that later. Right now Brent needs you urgently. We've worked out a plan against the Voids that he needs to discuss with you. He's on Néhma in the Behén System. I've got to get back to the lab, but send Brent my regards. Be seeing you!
Great. Still no date.
Keith! I have good news for you. We've finished analyzing the data from the Void mother ship and worked out a plan.
Yes?
The Void mother ship is the source of the wormholes. If we destroy it, we'll stop the Voids from raiding our star systems.
Er...
Unfortunately it's not susceptible to any of our existing weapons. We need an alternative.
Such as?

Using the probe's data, Deep Science has developed a special bomb which our Nivelian allies are about to complete. To be effective it must be detonated right at the heart of the mother ship. The best possible delivery for this bomb is inside a K'Sarr freighter. With its strong armor it'll reach the target even under heavy fire.
And where do we get a K'Sarr freighter?
Hopefully from Errkt Uggut, a Vossk commander on Ga'kkrr in the S'kolptorr star system.
The Vossk are still your enemy. How did you come to such an agreement?
Well, the only agreement we have so far is that our best pilot should go to Ga'kkrr to meet Errkt Uggut. Guess who that is.
Thanks, Brent. But do you seriously want me to negotiate with a Vossk for the fate of the galaxy?
What do you want me to say? Those are the conditions. Do whatever is necessary to get that freighter, Keith!
Well, for an extra payment I wouldn't say no.
Don't worry, I'll take care of that.
Keith T. Maxwell. I've heard a lot about you. You were a fighter pilot at Novaterra, if I'm not mistaken?
Yeah, that was me. People still talk about that battle?
No. I've just done some research on you before our meeting. I'm sure you did the same with me.
Erm... Naturally. But enough pleasantries. What about the freighter?
His Highness the Emperor has been informed about your intentions against the Voids our commom enemy and commands that the Empire shall take part in the mission.
Okay, I wasn't prepared for that.
There is too much at stake for the Empire. We can't hand over a K'Sarr without our supervision. It is the will of the Emperor that I shall pilot the K'Sarr myself.
So why did you ask for me?
The Emperor shall give you the honor of being my escort, should you be able to prove your skills. For that, meet me in orbit of the neighboring planet B'akka.
Who am I to disagree with the Emperor?
Terran! To prove your skills I will challenge you to a contest. We'll fly to a pirate's hideout and exterminate them. The one who shoots down the most pirates wins.
A contest? Now he's gone completely nuts. But if that's what it takes to get the freighter. I never liked pirates anyway.

You have beaten me and proven yourself worthy, Terran. You will have the honor of escorting me during the mission. Let me know when and where you need the K'Sarr freighter, and I shall be there. Luck in battle, Terran.
Same to you, Errkt. Hope there's time for a drink before I have to explain all this to Brent.
Are you out of your mind? I just received word from the Vossk Empire that Errkt Uggut will be piloting the freighter!
That's the Emperor's idea, not mine. I guess we have to live with it.
Well, as long as we get the ship, I suppose. But there are more urgent matters right now.
Something wrong with Carla?

Huh? It's nothing to do with Carla, Keith. The Nivelians have finished building the Deep Science bomb, but on its way to Néhma the convoy carrying the weapon parts was captured by the Mido Confederation. They're on their way to Eanya now.
Dammit! That's incredibly inconvenient.
Thanks to their ridiculous war with the Nivelians. Intercept the convoy in the Eanya System at Dekato.
Yes, Sir! I'm on my way.
There's the convoy, with a Mido fighter escort. I have to get rid of them without damaging the convoy ships.
Enemy fighter approaching! Intercept!
Brent? Keith here. The Mido ships are destroyed and the situation is under control.
Well done! Finally the convoy can get to Néhma. You should return here, so we can discuss our next move.
We have everything we need now. The Deep Science bomb has been assembled and loaded onto the Vossk freighter.
So Errkt Uggut and the freighter have arrived already. What do you think about him?
He looks pretty calm and doesn't really say much. Seems to be lost in his own world.
Hope he doesn't lose his nerve during the mission.

We're monitoring to see where the Voids will show up next. As soon as we spot them, you and Commander Errkt Uggut must get to that location and enter the wormhole. Keith, you'll provide cover for Errkt as he heads for the wormhole, then follow him through once he's made it to Void space.
Fine. Who's our backup?
We'll request support from the nearest station to the wormhole. You have to make sure the freighter isn't destroyed before it reaches the mother ship.
Errkt will bail out using his escape pod just before the detonation, so be sure to equip your ship with a scanner and a tractor beam. You won't have much time to pick him up, though.
Once you've recovered Urrkt, get back through the wormhole before the mother ship explodes, or it'll take you with it. Good luck, Keith!
I'm starting to regret volunteering for this mission...
Ok, there's the wormhole. Now I have to wait until Errkt arrives.
Mr. Maxwell? This is Lieutenant Baffour. My men and I will provide support as requested.
Ah, the reinforcements! Engage the Void fighters, Lieutenant! The freighter should be here any minute.
Terran! I've set a course for the wormhole. Give me cover!
Roger that!
The armor is reduced to fifty per cent.
Errkt made it to the wormhole. I have to follow him through...
Baffour's squad didn't make it through the wormhole on time. We're on our own, Errkt. The mother ship is straight ahead.
I'm already on a collision course, Terran. Get those fighters out of my path!
Roger. I'll keep them busy.
There's a loads of them! What's your status Errkt?
The armor is already damaged, but keep it up. We're almost at the mother ship.
Their defense is strong. I hope we pull through.
Don't let me down, Terran.
Watch out! They're attacking from the sides!
The engine is damaged! I'm losing control!
Errkt! Are you still alive?

Terran, the engines are dead and I'm stuck in the cockpit. I can't even detonate the bomb. You have to blow up the freighter. It's our only option. I will gladly share the fate of the Voids. For the Empire!
Don't be a hero, Errkt! Use the escape pod!
Negative! It's down. You need to destroy the freighter. Now!
Damn. The whole plan is going down the drain!
Sorry Errkt. Don't take it personally.
I've got to get out of here. This whole sector of space will be gone in a few seconds!
I did it! Man, that was close.
Computer, get me Carla on the line!
Keith are you alright? I was worried about you. Is everything okay?
Calm down Carla! Listen, everything's done, the galaxy is saved, and I'm coming to your place for our date now. Be ready!
Carla! Are you waiting for someone?
How about a drink stranger?
Keith! You did it! The wormholes are collapsing all across the galaxy. Well done!
Keith!
Keith? Where are you?
Dammit! Can someone please find him?
Wow, what a night. I might have had a drop too much. And Carla! Good god. Never thought she'd could knock 'em back like that.
Hey, where is she? I don't even remember her leaving.

Oh, a note:

"Keith darling, maybe I should have told you that yesterday was my last day on Thynome. I'm working on another secret project at a different research facility, so please don't try to find me. All the best for now! Someone with your talents is always needed, all over the galaxy. Thanks for last night - maybe we can do it again sometime.

Carla.

P.S. As final payment for your services to Deep Science, we'll transfer another 40,000 Credits to your account."

Hmm. What was the payment for anyway? I'm good, but I'm not that good.

Can't help feeling that I've just been used, though. Oh well, whatever. Time for another drink. I hope I can find my way back to the bar. Maybe I'll see if I can land another job while I'm there...
Incoming call detected.
Connect!
Keith Maxwell?
Keith T. Maxwell. And you are?
Call me Cornelius. My boss has a job for you.
Okay, Corny! What's the deal? You know I don't come cheap.
Payment is no problem. But we should discuss the details in person.
As you wish. Where should we meet?
I'll wait for you on the Kanado station.
Understood. See you then, Corny!
Mr. Maxwell? This way please.
Corny?
Enough foolishness, Mr. Maxwell. I have an assignment for you that my boss is willing to pay a large amount for. Let's get right to business.
That's how I like it.
If you've had your ear to the channels you'll already know that the Vossk are developing a series of new ships, including the K'Suukk. We are looking to acquire such a ship.
As far as I know, aside from the H'Soc, a Vossk ship can only be flown by Vossk.
That's right. But this ship is being developed for sale to other races. It will take a while until it's ready for the market. But since the boss wants to have it now, you have to steal it.
Why should I risk my reputation with the Vossk and how do you intend to go about it?

Why? Because we are willing to pay 200,000 credits for it. How? You'll be brought to B'akkram in the K'ontrr system. There you'll board the K'Suukk in time for a planned test flight and bring it here.
That's completely insane. How could that ever work?
A Vossk who owes us a favour will fly you there and smuggle you into the station. His name is Taret Orskk and he is from the same spawn pool as Mekant Orskk, who will then meet you with instructions.
So it's a family gathering! And what will happen to my ship in the meantime?
It will stay here during the mission. I guarantee you that you will find it exactly as you left it.
I wouldn't have it any other way, Corny. Where do I find this Taret Orskk?
Taret Orskk is waiting for you in his ship on platform B7. He'll give you further details. Good luck, Mr. Maxwell.
Okay, then. Be seeing you!
It's nice being chauffeured for a change!
The pleasure-cruise part of our mission is over now, Terran. Now it gets dangerous. The B'akrram station is directly ahead.
I'm just wondering how your uncle, or cousin, or whichever, is going to smuggle me onto this ship.
A test with the K'Suukk prototype is planned today. You'll wear this Vossk uniform and pose as a test pilot. During the test flight, break orbit and head for Kanado.
Understood. I should try get to a jump gate as fast as possible.
The moment you've left the station with the ship, my debt is settled and you're on your own.
Got it. Let's dock, Taret. In the meantime, I'll squeeze into this uniform.
Greetings, Terran.
Mekant Orskk, I presume?

Yes. Keep your voice down, Terran. Turn your helmet the right way, follow me and keep a low profile. If I'm caught for this treason, I'll be executed without trial and my clan will lose their premier spawn pool privileges!
Of course we wouldn't want to risk that.

I hope that was not a form of Terran sarcasm.

Here is the K'Suukk. Get in and leave the station immediately. If all goes well everyone will think it's the planned test flight. There's a jump gate in the next orbit, if you make it that far!
That's the plan! Does this ship have weapons too?

The K'Suukk is equipped with three scatterguns. But I hope you won't need to use them on my brethren. Now leave the station and keep calm so that no one gets suspicious.

The entry hatch is over there. I'll leave you now.
Take care, Mekant.
So far no one seems to have noticed anything. Now to find the way to Kanado. Where is that darn jump gate?
Pilot, there is too much deviation from the permitted waypoints. Correct your course!
I knew it! The Vossk can't be deceived that easily.
The pilot is not responding. The K'Suukk prototype is approaching the jump gate. Alert all vessels!
Oh, great!
Target object sighted! Intercept!
This just keeps getting better and better!
We have to stop him! The K'Suukk must not fall into the wrong hands!
I have to reach the jump gate!
Done! I'll be safe here for now.
Well done, Mr. Maxwell. It's a fine ship, this K'Suukk, isn't it?
To hell with that! Thanks to your lousy plan I almost got blasted to bits! I was surrounded by trigger-happy Vossk!
The ship is here and you're alive, that's all that matters now.
Maybe to you, but now I've lost favour with the Vossks.

I've transferred 200,000 credits to your account. I hope that soothes your loss. My boss would like to meet you in person. There are opportunities to make more easily earned credits. Fly to Valkyrie in the Herjaza system if you're interested.
Easily earned, don't make me laugh! And what system is that? I've never heard of it.
I've sent the coordinates to your onboard computer and you can find your ship in the hangar, without a scratch, as promised.
Lucky for you! See you around.
This should be the right place.
Hm, strange station.
Nice of you to visit us, Maxwell! Welcome to Valkyrie.
My pleasure. I have an appointment to see your boss.
That's me. Call me Alice. By the way, good job getting the K'Suukk. Are you ready for another assignment?
I see, so you're the boss. Then you should be aware that I nearly got incinerated during the K'Suukk heist?
I'm sure that a seasoned pilot such as yourself is used to situations like that. I sought you out because I heard you're the best.
I am the best! May I ask what you intend to do with the K'Suukk?

You may not. But let me put it this way: The more good ships we have, the better our business runs. And that brings me right to your next assignment. Of course only if you can use the 100,000 credits.
Keep talking.

We've been developing an automatic turret that that needs testing in the field, to prove its worthiness. We are especially keen to learn how it fares against the new Vossk range of ships. That is why we would like you to fly into the neighboring orbit of Scion, with an escort, and test it on the pirates there. The test ship will be fitted with the turret, but you can't take any other weapons besides that.
And why is that?

So we can get accurate results of its effectiveness, without interference. But you were going to stop asking questions now. You should be on your way. The S'Kanarr is waiting for you in the hangar. And you can keep your ship here in the meantime.
S'Kanarr? Never heard of it. What kind of ship is that?
Are you still asking questions? It's another Vossk innovation, modified for multi-species use. You don't need to know anything else right now.
Fair enough.
Mr. Maxwell. Targets identified at the next waypoint. Prepare to commence turret performance test.
Thank you.
We're under attack!
Not bad!
Nice firing rate!
He can't handle it alone. All units, fire at will!
Impressive. The turret seems to be doing a good job. Return to base!
Without the right maneuvers to back it up, this weapon isn't that great.
Ah, Maxwell. At last!
I hope your analyists were able to collect enough data during the battle.
Yes. Thanks to you. It seems as if the turret is ready for production. Your credits were transferred and I already have another lucrative assignment lined up for you.
I'm listening.

We're in the process of creating prototypes for the 'Liberator' guided missiles. We need ten of them to make an extensive test. Unfortunately we lack a few key elements for their construction. But being the resourceful man you are, I think you can change that. Here's a list of the required materials.
This is a tall order, it might take a while. What's in it for me, exactly?
Don't worry, we'll make it worth your while. How does 150,000 credits sound? And if the production runs smoothly, we'll have a much more interesting job for you.
Guided missiles, now that would be nice!
Excellent, then we are in agreement. We'll speak again when you have all the parts.
You can find the list of required parts and materials in the blueprints overview.
You have delivered all of the components for the Liberator. Fly back to Valkyrie to receive further instructions from Alice.
Mission accomplished. That was quite a shopping list! So what happens next?
It's about time you got back here! We've just assembled ten of the prototypes and can start testing them out right away. And I have just the targets for you to try them out on.
So you want me to test these missiles? What kind of targets are we talking about here?
As soon as you've installed the Liberators, I want you to send them right up the back end of some old friends of mine.
Sounds like a vendetta.

They're wannabe weapons dealers who are flooding the market with cheap imitations. They've been stepping on my toes for too long now. It's time to show them that I really mean business, and you're going to help me do just that!
Okay then, what's the plan?

I've discovered that they are in the process of making a delivery at this very moment. I'll transfer the coordinates of their freight ships to your computer. Make sure that none of the freighters reach their destination. And by the way, I'll pay 50,000 credits for this.
Only 50,000 credits?

If you want to earn more credits, use the Liberators. I'll pay an extra 50,000 credits for every freighter that you destroy with this weapon. Attack from a distance, because the freighters are extremely well armed.
Okay, I hope these things really are as good as you say they are.
The map and mission description will give you information about the location of the target ships.
He's getting too close. Take him out!
That was the first freighter! Two more to go.
We're being targeted! Fire at will!
And now to locate the last freighter!
Hostile approach! Keep your distance!
That's all of them! Now to see Alice and claim my reward.
Alice, the Liberators work fine. Both the controls and the detonator.
Excellent! Of course we knew that the Liberators would be flawless. After all, I designed them myself. But I have more important things to attend to right now.
Okay Alice, mission accomplished. Freighters intercepted and destroyed. What's next?
Oh, Maxwell. I'm a little pre-occupied with more important matters right now.
I see. And what might they be, if I may ask?
What? More questions? Look, your credits have been transferred. If there are any remaining Liberators you can keep them. I'll be in touch.
I've heard that one before.
Good, then you're used to it. That's all. Dismissed.
Dismissed? Who does she think she's talking to?
Fine then, if I'm not needed here, I'll just be on my way! She can find another whipping boy.
Incoming call from Dr. Paolini.
Really? Carla!
Keith! Can you hear me?
Carla! Yes, loud and clear. But I'd much prefer seeing you! Where are you?
Come to the Beidan system as soon as possible. I'm here on a secret Deep Science research station. I'll send you the coordinates. I hope you still have the Khador drive.
Yes, I have it.
Repeat, please. You're breaking up.
I'm on my way!
So this is where Carla has been hiding herself.
Keith! Thank goodness you could get here so quickly! We have a problem!
We certainly do! You left me twiddling my thumbs on Thynome!
We'll discuss that later. Khador is missing.
Okay, what happened?
He vanished during a test flight with one of the prototypes.
What was he testing?
It's a prototype of our new ship series, with a permanently integrated Khador drive.
Hmm, so Khador and the ship are missing.
Our scanners registered strong electromagnetic waves after his entry into the Skavac system.
Most likely EMP weapons then. Could be he was hijacked. Give me the coordinates for the Skavac system and I'll investigate.
Hijacked? That would be bad. Here are the coordinates together with Khador's ship signature. I hope he's okay.
Clear enough space for an extra ship in the hangar, I'll be right back.
Thanks, Keith!
Oh, great! It looks as if Khador jumped right into a nest of pirates.
Where is Khador? Answer me now or I'll blast everything to pieces!
Looks like we got us a tough guy! Take him out, boys!
Okay, you win! If you're talking about that grey-headed dude who won't shut up, he's being taken to Nosdron.
All right then! Why didn't you say so before?
There! That must be Khador! The signatures match. Khador! Can you hear me?
Mr. Maxwell. You're coming to rescue me! How very nice of you! How have you been since we last met?
No time to chat, Khador. First I have to take care of your escort.
We've been spotted! Don't let him get away!
I need to make sure that Khador's ship isn't destroyed.
Fall back! This haul ain't worth dying for.
Cowards!
Khador? Are you okay?
As circumstances permit, Mr. Maxwell. You have my utmost gratitude. These pirates kidnapped me and wanted to bring me into a neighboring system whose name they didn't mention.
Did you find out what they wanted from you?

No, unfortunately I did not ascertain their intentions for me, but they seemed pre-occupied with this ship. We should return to Kothar as quickly as possible. There is a considerable likelihood that more of these pirates are in our immediate vicinity.
Okay, Khador. Let's get back.
Here we are. By the way, your Khador drive is outstanding.

Thank you, Mr. Maxwell. I'll take that as a compliment on my research work. Unfortunately the manufacturing process continues to be complicated. It requires crystals from the world of the Voids. As you know, they don't exist anywhere else. They can only be reached with my drive. This is... how do you say... a vicious cycle?
You could say that. But you were still able to produce additional drives?
Yes, but it's always a time-consuming and dangerous enterprise. Deep Science is currently trying to integrate the drive into a new range of ships such as this one.
Yeah, Carla mentioned that. If you need help getting Void crystals or other items, just let me know.
Thank you, Mr. Maxwell. I'll be glad to take you up on that kind offer.
Hold that thought, I'm getting a call.
Maxwell! Come to Valkyrie immediately! I have a job for you.
You don't say. Now you need me again after all?
Come here at once!
Alice, listen... she hung up. That woman obviously has a problem.
Khador?
Reading you loud and clear, Mr. Maxwell!
Let's dock.
Keith! I knew we could count on you! I can't imagine what might have happened if you hadn't been there.
No problem, Carla.
Now that Khador is back, we can return to work at once on the new models. We could even have a ship ready for you too the next time you come.
Carla, actually I thought I could stick around, maybe enjoy some time together...
While my colleagues go on working without me? I'm sorry, Keith, it will have to wait to another time. I can't leave my post.
I thought as much. Oh well, I guess I'll go see what Alice wants instead.
Alice?
Oh, a client who gave me a few very lucrative assignments.
What does she look like, this Alice?
Hey, nowhere near as hot as you!
Keith! No, wait, you got me wrong...
Excuse me? Hey, I happen to know...
If she, never mind... it might just be a coincidence, but...
What? You don't know this Alice, do you?
Oh, forget it. I have to get back to work. Come visit me again soon, and then I'll have more time for you. I promise!
In that case, I'll be seeing you soon!
Could Carla be jealous? Or is there more to this than meets the eye. I think I'll pay Alice a visit.
Maxwell! You've come!
What's going on?
We're having a problem with the pirates in the neighboring system. They have something that belongs to me and I want it, at any price.
What is it?
You don't need to know that. Your job is to provide distraction while one of my men infiltrates the pirate station.
Distraction? That's not my strong point. I normally like to kick the door down.
Yes, yes. There's a fresh shipment of mines ready for you in the hangar. This could make it a little more interesting for you. If you do this right, we'll pay you 150,000 credits.
Okay. But I prefer working alone. What should I look for on the station?
As I said, just take care of the pirates. Tenner will handle the rest.
Mr. Maxwell! So we meet again.
Corny?
Cornelius Tenner, that's my name. Equip your ship with the mines from the hangar. Follow me to the Skavac system when you're ready.
Follow the waypoints to the station, Mr. Maxwell.
What are we supposed to be looking for out here?
The pirates promised a delivery. And the boss paid through the nose for it. We haven't heard from that scum since.
Got it. Then let's not waste time. I'll fly ahead.
Wait here while I create a slight disturbance.
Okay, I'll wait for your signal.
Unauthorized vessel approaching! Scramble all ships!
Cornelius, move in! But make it fast!
Just don't blow up the station with me still inside!
Have some faith!
That should be enough. Now, where's Cornelius?
I don't understand it, I didn't find anything.
Oh, great! All that work for nothing.
The boss will go bezerk!
Yeah, well you can give her the news. She can contact me if she needs me.
Okay, I'll let her know. Over and out.
I wouldn't want to trade places with poor Cornelius right now. Ah, a call from Khador! Hey, Khador? What's up?

Mr. Maxwell! Would you mind if I take a moment of your valuable time? When last we met you offered your help if I ever needed it. It would now be a good time for my humble self to take advantage of your generous offer, should it still stand.
Whatever you want, Khador, but please get to the point.
My esteemed friend and colleague, Netor, requires a sample of concentrated crystals from the world of the Voids for our joint research in the area of monochromatic molecular emissions.
You mean the crystal cores?
Exactly. You would do Netor and I a great courtesy if you could acquire for him a sample of these crystal cores. Netor resides on the Inari Onu station in the Vulpes system.
Okay. I'll see what I can do. Speak to you soon, Khador.
This little side-mission is perfect for me right now. I'll get back to Alice when she's calmed down a bit.
Mr. Maxwell, unfortunately the boss is quite busy at the moment. She would like me to tell you that she'll contact you when she's ready.
Mr. Maxwell. Khador has already told me a great deal about you. I'm very pleased to meet you. Why don't you follow me into my lab.
I'll be glad to, Khador... I mean, Netor. I heard you were in need of this crystal core?
Yes, thank you, it's exactly what I've been looking for. With the aid of the crystal cores, the energy capacity of the Disruptor Laser could be greatly increased.
Disruptor Laser? Is that a weapon you're developing?

The Disruptor Laser was originally designed for deep space construction work, until I accidentally discovered its extraordinary properties in shield interference. Here you can see the current state of development.
I only see an empty holder. And a slime trail...

What? Oh no, what a catastrophe! The Disruptor Laser has been stolen. It was still in place a few minutes ago.

This slime... it's from a Multipod. That could only have been my assistant, Trot Lykkt.
A Multipod? I just saw one in the hangar and he was in a real hurry to get to his ship. He can't have gotten far. I'll grab him!

Be careful, Mr. Maxwell. If Trot Lykkt has mounted the Disruptor Laser on his ship, he could be very dangerous indeed. Do whatever you can to stop him. This technology must not get into the wrong hands.
No worries, I'll take care of it.
Crud! He's leaving the orbit.
He's flying to Lopat. After him!
I have to stop him before he reaches the jump gate!
Trot Lykkt! Surrender, or I'll open fire!
So you're going to try and stop me? Well, this is an excellent opportunity to test out the Disruptor Laser.
Bloody hell! He means business!
Netor won't be happy that his research project was destroyed, but I had no other choice. I better return to Inari Onu right away.
Mr. Maxwell! You're back! What happened?
Your Disruptor Laser is space dust. And your assistent too. I'm sorry, I had no other choice.
I see, that's very unfortunate. Nonetheless, I'd like to thank you for helping me. But now I see that the Disruptor Laser is just too dangerous after all. I should stop developing it immediately.
It would be a shame to waste all that work.
Mr. Maxwell, do me the favour of taking this blueprint off my hands. I no longer feel safe with it, nor with the crystal core. I'm sure you can use the Disruptor Laser in a more meaningful way.
Thank you, Netor. I promise to use it for good purposes. Most of the time anyway. Take care.
Goodbye, Mr. Maxwell.
Well, well. Alice is contacting me again. Computer, connect!
Maxwell, the last assignment did not go the way I wanted, but at least you followed instructions exactly as I asked.
No problem, but I'm still waiting for my credits.
I've transferred them now.
Thank you. No hard feelings, then?
Let's not discuss it any further. Something new has come up. There's a convoy carrying a secret weapons shipment on its way to Eanya in the Midorian border area, by way of Teres.
Let me guess, you want to get your hands on that shipment.
Use EMP weapons to disable the engines. That should also prevent the cargo from beging damaged. As soon as you're done, send your exact position. My men will come to collect the freight.
Okay. I'll take care of the EMP weapons. What's in it for me?
150,000 credits.
I'm sure it's worth much more than that to you. That shipment must be worth millions.
Don't push me, Maxwell. As a sign of good will, I'll increase the reward to 250,000 credits.
Let's say 300,000!
I have no choice but to agree, for now! Don't bother me again until it's done. Now get to work!
Alice? She hung up again. I have to take a closer look at that convoy. I have the feeling that there's more to this than a just few weapons.
That must be the convoy. I have to get closer.
Pirates! They always show up at the worst moment.
Ahoy, fellas! We've got a customer.
I shouldn't spend too much time on them. I can't let the convoy get away.
Okay, time to use the EMP. I'm curious to see what's really in that hold.
We're under attack!
That should do it!
Oh, crud! There's even more of them!
I've taken control of the convoy. Now the ball is in your court! Surrender!
Okay, what do you want?
What is your freight and who is it for?
We're carrying drive components for a Grey named Khador. We're to meet him on his research station. You can have the cargo, if you leave my crew unharmed!
Khador? So, no weapons after all. Then what does Alice want with this stuff?
What do you plan to do with us now?
Try starting your engines. I'll accompany you to Kothar.
I don't understand. I didn't say where we were heading. Do you actually know this Khador?
I do. Don't worry. I'll resolve this matter with him.
Keith? Nice to see you. How come you accompanied our convoy? Was it an assignment that I'm unaware of?
Oh, boy. It's a long story. Where should I start...
What? Your sister?
I'm pretty sure! She dropped out of the Academy and joined a group of mercenaries. She wanted the fame, fortune and excitement, not a boring scientist job. That was the last I saw of her.
Hmm, fame, or infamy. She's become a rather unscrupulous weapons dealer and certainly has enough money, that's for sure.
Weapons dealer? How awful!
Why do you think she was interested in the convoy's freight?
The convoy had pre-assembled components for several Khador drives on board. Maybe she found out about them.
I see, the pieces of the puzzle are falling together now.
Do you have any idea what she's planning?
I have a suspicion. But I'll see what I can drag out of her.
You're going back there?
Don't worry, I'll just ask a few questions.
Please be careful, Keith. Sometimes she can be unpredictable.
Yes, I noticed that. I'll contact you as soon as I know more.
Just a word, Mr. Maxwell.
Khador. I'm sorry, I'm in a rush.
I certainly don't want to delay you. But you could do me a great service while you're on your next mission.
If it's quick.

Oh, definitely. It won't impede you at all. You see, we equipped a new ship with a Khador drive a few hours ago. Please use this ship on your upcoming travels and evaluate the drive's functionality for us. But carry your regular Khador drive on board also, just in case.
In case the installed one fails?
According to our calculations, the integrated drive should be 98% reliable. Unfortunately, there is always a residual risk, since the production process is not yet fully optimized.
I think I'll take the risk! The ship's in the hangar?
That's right. And don't forget your Khador drive. I would hate to think of you stranded, floating around a strange galaxy in case something doesn't work as expected.
Got it, Khador. See you later.
Maxwell! Of all the nerve! Why didn't you contact me? What happened to the convoy?
Don't get worked-up, Alice. I don't know exactly what you're planning, but it can't be anything good. I spoke to Carla.
Carla? Carla! That... Damn it! Why is everything going wrong? First that business with Khador and now the convoy. It's driving me nuts!
I had an idea that you had something to do with Khador's hijacking.
Don't tell me you were the one who freed him?
That's right, Alice. Thanks to my Khador drive, I was able to be in Skavac just in time to prevent the handover.
Khador drive? You have one? You had one this whole time?
Yes, I...
You over there, Tenner!
Yes, boss!
Grab a few men and search Maxwell's ship. Take out anything that's blinking suspiciously or looks like a drive.
You got it, boss!!
What are you planning to do with my Khador drive?

Isn't it obvious? Whoever holds the plans for the Khador drive will dominate the market and dictate the prices. I will create a blueprint from your drive. Companies like AMR and Berger will pay any price to get their hands on a drive like that. Of course we'll have to change the name to a more fitting one. What do you think of the "Alice Drive"?
Very creative, really. But you're forgetting that Deep Science has built additional drives.
And that's why that's the first thing on my list, a little visit to the Deep Science research station.
You won't get very far with your little gang of minions. It would take more than a few good ships and weapons to take on a space station.

Maxwell. If everyone thought as small as you, we'd still be on Earth, picking nits out of each others hair. I'm not planning to fly with a ship. Oh and give my thanks to your onboard computer for the coordinates to Kothar.
Oh, crap!
You may go now. Your ship is over there. Sorry if my men were a little untidy in there. You can personally complain to my "little gang of minions".
Bloody hell! I underestimated Alice.
Woah! I didn't know it could do that!
I have to get to Carla! I certainly hope this integrated Khador drive works.
You heard what the boss said. Kill him!
Flipping heck! What did Khador build here? Let's try this again!
I hope I'm not too late!
No! Alice, what are you doing? Have you gone insane?
Don't take it personally, sister dear, but you're getting in the way of my plans.
I have to stop Alice! The station must have a few weak points.
Alice! What is wrong with you?
Prepare to fire! On my ordersl... what? Maxwell?
Keith!
How did you get here so fast? And why are you still alive?
Too many questions, Alice! You didn't pay me for those!
Retreat! Activate the Alice drive!
What was that sound? Initiate that damn drive now!
I'm not done with you yet!
Blast! She got away! Carla, can you find out where she jumped to?
The energy emissions were unusually high. Something must have gone wrong with the jump. I just hope she's still alive.
She just tried to kill you, Carla!
I know, but she's still my little sister.
I'm coming on board.
Good, then you can tell me what this Alice drive is all about.
What's this? Where are we? Charge the Alice drive!
We don't have any more energy cells, I'm sorry.
What? Am I completely surrounded by buffoons here? You better get that drive to work, now!
Aaargh! Don't tell me we're stuck out here in the middle of nowhere!
Thanks, Keith, if it hadn't been for you...
I've been hearing that a lot lately. This station needs a standing army!
Or at least better security. We never expected to face an attack like that! I can't believe that Alice would go so far.
Let's just hope that she doesn't return any time soon.
I hope that these events will make her rethink her career choice.
We'll see, after all, hope is the last thing to die. I think we could use a drink now.
Hm, maybe that would put us in a better mood. What do you feel like?
Oh boy, I'd wrestle a Rhinocitroll for a Union beer or does this station have any Y'mirr liquor?
Crud, another night of heavy boozing with Carla. Maybe we shouldn't have challenged those lab guys to a drinking contest...
Come to think of it, I think Carla actually won. Where is she, anyway?
A note? Oh no! I'm having an unpleasant déjà-vu.

Keith Darling.

As you've probably figured out by now, I had to rush back to work. The station took a big hit and some of the labs are completely destroyed. I'll be busy all day. But how about we see each other tonight?

Yours, Carla

P.S.: Why don't you take a look inside the hangar? A few new ships have been rolled out.

P.P.S.: The S'kolptorr rum on the table is yours, at least whatever is left. You won it yesterday in the drinking contest.
Well, at least she didn't take off without a word. Let's see what goodies are in the hangar!

Mr. Maxwell! Thank you for evaluating the ship that I provided for you. Your assistance made it possible for me to resolve a variety of errors in the perpetual motion device. Now the drive functions flawlessly.
My pleasure.

Please keep the Cronus as a mark of our appreciation for your tireless dedication. If you have any interest in this ship series in the future, two additional models will be ready for you in the hangar of this station. Visit us again soon.
I'll do that. Good work, Khador. See you later.
Is it... Keith Maxwell? Keith, please! Dock here and get me off this awful tin can!
Now why would I want to do that? I think that's the perfect place for you right now, sweetheart!
Maxwell? Let's just forget everything, okay, let bygones be bygones? Get me off of here, please?
Please? You should have thought of that sooner. No chance.
Hello! Can anyone hear me? I want to get out of here!
In space, Alice, you can scream as much as you like...
Maxwell! A million credits if you take me away from here!
Nice try! Forget it.
Two million!
I should get out of here, otherwise I might be tempted!
Tenner, you idiot! Why don't we have enough energy cells on board? I want to get out of here!
I... I'm already working on a solution. But it might take a few years until enough energy is collected.
A few years? You must be joking!
How are you today, Alice?
Don't play with me, Maxwell! If I get my hands on you, you're dead meat!
Oooh, then I better steer clear of you.
Maxwell! Get me out of here, I can't stand it anymore!
Why don't you pass the time with the Voids? I'm just here for the ore.
Boss, a ship is approaching!
Maxwell, you again? Are you just coming here to taunt me?
I'm sorry, Alice. No time for chit-chat. I'm just passing through.
Hi Keith! We're transferring the Deep Science team back to Thynome. Kothar station is still being repaired from the battle with Valkyrie.
A sound plan! How about I pick you up so we can make the journey, um, uninterrupted.
Hi Lovey! Are you ready to take me to Thynome?
Hey, I'll take you anywhere if you ask me that nicely!
I can't wait to see my new living pod. There's a flotation tank, and a quad-sized bed!
A quad-sized bed, now that sounds like fun!
You know, Keith, I've been thinking...
Well, that's nice to hear!
Stop it, silly! Isn't it time we got a little more serious? I mean, us, taking our relationship to the next level? You could move in with me on Thynome, there's plenty of room...
Hey, if you cook and I can drink beer, I'm all up for it.
Oh great! Now we should discuss decor. I've been looking through the scans for the perfect curtains...
Oh yeah... Curtains... My favorite subject.
A few months later...
Carla, I'm heading off. See you when I see you...
Hey, not so fast! Where are you going?
Well, you know, Carla, there's always work to be done... I need to make a living... Space to be explored and all that...
But you have enough to do here, Keith! We need to finish renovating our suite... The permit for our partnership augmentation could be approved any moment now!
I should really get going, Carla... You know how to reach me... I'm sure I heard of pirates in some zone or other...
Don't give me that crap, mister! We're having dinner with the Tweezleboks later. They just had a new extension put on their pod!
Oh the Seven's bells! I hope something happens somewhere... Soon!
Meanwhile in Midorian space...
Keith, Keith! Do you read me?
Gunant! Long-time no see! How are you?
Keith! You must save my son! There is a most dire situation unfolding and I am trying every recourse...
Calm down! What's going on exactly?

My son, Gunant IV, and his crew are on a damaged freighter deep in the Valpatro orbit and we can't get a vessel close enough to make an extraction. Your ship might be able to infiltrate the area and stage a rescue operation.
Okay. But what happened to the freighter?
It seems the sun of the Ginoya system exploded and devastated the inner planets. Nothing like we've ever seen. We're receiving distress signals from several of our mining outposts in that area.
I see. That is serious. I'll do my best to save them.
Be sure to bring enough passenger cabins! There are ten miners on board. Please, hurry!
Oh, wow! This really is bad. It's like a tanning salon gone haywire!
The gamma rays are off the scale! I'll need to hurry before my hull is incinerated!

The station has been obliterated!
I hope those guys are still alive. Does anybody read me?
Yes, we're here! Dock on as fast as you can. We have casualties and the whole ship is about to break apart.
I'm on my way!
Everyone hurry, get on board!
That's the last one, let's get the injured to Tadram, fast!
Hold tight in the passenger cabin! We're on our way, and not a second too soon!
That was a close call!
Hailing approaching vessel. Tadram station has become unstable due to the gamma rays. Docking is no longer possible.
Listen, I have ten Midorians from Valpatro on board who need medical treatment. Can I leave them on your freighter?
Yes, of course. We can take care of them. But be quick, as we're preparing to depart for the safety of Talidor.
That radiation! I don't have much time. I need to dock at the freighter.
What the... we've got company!
I've never seen ships like these before.
Whoa. Where did they go? Some kind of cloaking device?
I'd better handle these guys so the freighter can make its getaway.
Captain, that was the last of them! Safe journey to Talidor.
Well done! Over and out.
Gunant, do you read me?
Keith, do you have any news of my son?
Your son is safe and on his way to the Talidor system. But the situation looks bad. It's like we're dealing with some kind of supernova.
Thanks for saving my son, Keith. Our scientists are speculating that the whole Mido sector could be at risk of burning up. Many stations and some entire planets need evacuating!
Who is coordinating the operations? I'd like to help any way I can.
That's very noble of you, Keith! Bargand Surr is in charge. You can find him in the Talidor system in Midantha.
I'd better be on my way then. Take care, Gunant.
Keith T. Maxwell! I wanted to personally express my gratitude for your selfless and courageous act in saving the miners.
Hey, I like to give back once in a while! I can see that this is a time of great need for the Midorians, so you can count on me as a volunteer in your efforts.
Back at Tadram station I was attacked by several unidentified vessels, can you tell me anything about this?
To be honest, we're flummoxed. It could be that some outlaw elements are trying to take advantage of the current chaos for their own gain.
Well, they were certainly too technologically advanced for pirates. I've never encountered stealth ships like these.
Stealth ships? Ah, that's why we've recently had several reports of sightings of strange vessels in our systems. This is all quite worrying...

But we should first look to the urgent matters at hand! We could use you at the Luur station where a hundred crew are in need of immediate evacuation. Would you be willing to undertake such a large operation?
Like I said, I'll help how I can, but I'll probably need hull enhancements before going back out in that gamma storm...
We've thought of that already. We'll provide you with a gamma shield. This should afford you more time in the affected zone.
And for protection, look in the hangar for our latest turret. You might need one just in case there's a repeat of the last incident.
Great, Bargand. I'll equip the shield right away and check out this new turret. Then I'll head straight to Luur station.
Keith T. Maxwell hailing Midorian freighter. Bargand Surr sent me to support the evacuation. Who's in charge here?
Captain Squand here. We really could use your help right now! We need to get the entire crew off the damaged station and onto the freighter.
Okay, I'm on the task.
These guys again! It seems like they're trying to disrupt the evacuations.
Hailing unknown vessel. This is a rescue operation, turn around immediately or you will be fired upon!
No answer. Well, they asked for it.
We have all the crew on board and can now depart the orbit. Thanks and good-bye, Mr Maxwell!
Hailing Bargand Surr! Come in! The evacuation is complete, everyone is safe.
Well done, Mr Maxwell! Your assistance is proving invaluable.
You're welcome, Bargand! But our problems are worsening by the minute. There must be a direct relation between the gamma ray bursts and the arrival of the stealth fighters.
That's what we are currently assuming. There is news pouring in of more widespread attacks. We have made contact with the Terran Fleet Commander, Brent Snocom, in an urgent request for aid.
Snocom is a good man. He won't turn a blind eye to this mess.
Don't forget that there is a Nivelian embargo on our faction. The Terrans might prefer to maintain their volatile peace with the Nivelian Republic.
I'll fly to Alioth station at once and talk to Snocom. I'm sure something can be arranged.
Meanwhile, back on Thynome station...
I wish I could get a signal to Keith, but the gamma ray interference is jamming all communications. How am I supposed to match these curtain proposals by myself?
Doctor Paolini? We have two new visitors on board who wish to speak with you, a Professor Moonsprocket and a Doctor Lampeter?
What? Moonsprocket? Oh no! What's he doing here?
Doctor Paolini! How nice to see you again!
Professor Moonsprocket! You've returned to us! I didn't think we'd see you around here again after what happened last time!
What's that? No recollection at all, my dear! I've come because of the anomaly in the Midorian sector. I believe I may have some valuable information on the matter.
The supernova? I suppose we can accommodate you, but we may have to keep the lounge off-limits for the time being, for all our safety... May I ask who is accompanying you on your visit?
What? Oh, yes, of course! Allow me to introduce my psychiatrist, Doctor Brillo Lampeter.
A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am acting as assistant to the illustrious archaeologist, Professor Thadellonius Moonsprocket in all his psychological and pharmaceutical needs!
That's, um, reassuring ...
Oh, Carla! I've just heard rumor that that awful man Moonsprocket is back on the station! Ah, oh... oh dear! Hello, Professor!
Khador, my old chum! Just like the old days, yes? How nice to see you! I hear you have been working hard at finding the cause of the disturbances? Come to any conclusion yet? Eh?
Well, yes, I suppose... All indications point to a correlation with an early-stage supernova, although this would be impossible given the age of any of the stellar bodies in this sector...

Haha! Spot on, old chap! Listen, I may have just the thing for you to solve the problem. Now where did I put it...? Damned, it was a rectangular thing. All this space travel does make me dizzy. Maybe a drink will jog my memory! What do you say, Brillo?
Indubitably, Professor!
Just what I need right now! I hope Moonsprocket doesn't go berserk like last time. I'll have to put my management skills on full alert, and keep him away from Khador before sparks start flying!
Hello, Brent! I've heard that Bargand Surr asked the Terran Fleet for help.
Hi, Keith! Yes you are correctly informed. We've discussed the issue and decided to send carriers with dropships to aid in the evacuations. What can you tell us about the Midorian situation?

It looks bad, I'm afraid. Their stations are taking a hammering from the intensity of the gamma rays, and stealth fighter attacks are disrupting the rescue efforts. The Midorians have barely had a chance to catch their breaths yet.

The Deep Science team is working day and night to find a solution to the anomaly. It's playing havoc with our communications, so we can't tell for certain what's going on either. But the stealth fighters are another thing...
I couldn't get any signature from them. I can't even venture a guess where they're from.

We've been contacted by the new leader of the Nivelian Republic, Trunt Harval. He assumed political and military leadership at the same time as the supernova. Surprisingly, he's offering to help with the evacuations. He also mentioned stealth fighters sighted along the shared Midorian border.
Hmm. I'd like to speak to him personally if it's possible. Maybe he can provide more information on these stealth fighters.
Oh, well, I'll make an appointment for you. He's at Genoh in the Nesla system at the moment.
Thanks, Brent. I'll see you. Bye.
Take care out there, Keith!
This is Keith T. Maxwell. I'm here under a diplomatic flag to meet Trunt Harval.
Mr Maxwell. We appreciate your visit. We are currently indisposed, however, due to heavy pirate attacks. Please feel welcome to call again at a later time.
Ugh, no time to waste. I should lend a hand...
That was the last of them.

Thank you for getting rid of that scum, Mr Maxwell. Unfortunately due to pirate activities, Trunt Harval has temporarily relocated to the Paréah system. Please proceed to Katashán where chief director Harval awaits you!
You could have told me earlier and saved me the bother!
Welcome, Mr Maxwell. I am Trunt Harval, chief director of the Nivelian Republic.
Keith T. Maxwell. A pleasure and an honor.
Likewise. I've come to hear that you have encountered these stealth fighters?
Yes, that's why I came here. Perhaps we can compare notes.
That's an excellent thought. Do you have any thoughts as to their origin?
Not a clue. But I do know how to tackle them!
You do?
Hah, they'll have to try harder to bring me down! They have the stealth technology which makes them a bit annoying - definitely not just your random pirate.
You fought them, and... survived? This is interesting. You must have many gods of fortune on your side, Mr Maxwell!
It was easy enough. They weren't too tricky, despite the disappearing act. How about your guys? How have they fared against them?

We thought their stealth capabilities gave them a competitive edge. But it's good to know that there is a way to counter them. I'll have to inform my fleet. Well, look how the time has passed. I'll better not keep you any longer. Goodbye, Mr Maxwell.
My time? Oh... He's gone. Must be a busy man. Hmm, I didn't find out much from this meeting but at least I won their hearts and minds. Better get back to Brent and report.
Meanwhile back on Thynome station...
Ah, there you are, Doctor Paolini!
Professor, hello!
I've found it! I found my ancient data stick!
What on Janice's Satellites are you talking about?
My data stick! It's an oblong form of physical memory. It was very deep in the pocket of my other trousers...
Excuse me? I think I've heard quite enough crudity for one meeting, Professor...
No, wait! It's just a kind of obsolete storage! I simply need to find the right object to insert it into! Just look at it! Oh no, where did it go now... It's in here somewhere!
Professor Moonsprocket... We had plenty of your antics here last time and you were asked to leave before, I'm afraid I'll have to do so again.
But... But I'm only trying to help! This could be of tremendous importance!
You're not being helpful, you're being weird. Please leave.
I... I suppose I should go then. I'll leave the data stick here on your desk... See? If you get the opportunity, please take a look at it. You'll find me at the bar.
Okay, well, maybe I'll look at it later... goodbye, Professor.
What's going on? Stealth fighters! And they're gunning for me!
I thought they would only loot evacuation ships. I'll need to be on my guard...
Ah, Keith! So how did your meeting go with Trunt Harval?
Well, rather strange, I'd say. Trunt Harval is polite, and was certainly interested in hearing about my exploits, but he seemed to be preoccupied with something.
Preoccupied?
It seemed he was very surprised that I survived and even destroyed some stealth fighters...
Maybe he was entranced by your famous charisma?
What? I don't think so. I just can't put my finger on it. But never mind. What's new with our Midorian friends?
We're about to send another carrier with dropships to evacuate Tadram. But we're still having trouble with stealth fighter attacks.
I can pitch in on the effort if you can use me. If I go home to Carla, it'll just be domestic chores.

That would be of great help. Mind that the dropships are the most vulnerable part of the procedure. They need to be protected during the operation. We'll transfer a repair beam to your cargo hold. Use it to patch up damaged ships.
I'll do that! See you later, Brent.
Maxwell, good you've come! The evacuations have already begun. Everything appears quiet so far.
The dropships are transporting evacuees from the station to the carrier.
If you have a repair beam installed, be sure to stay close to damaged dropships so it can do its work.
Here they come. Remember, protect the dropships at all costs!
Damn it, we lost the first dropship.
There goes another one. I must concentrate my efforts on the dropships.
Ah hells! With only one dropship left, this evacuation is going to take forever!
We did it! Everyone's on board. Thanks for your help, Maxwell. Carrier crew, prepare to jump.
They should be safe now, time to jump out of here.
Keith, please come in!
Ah, Carla!
Finally, I got through to you! It's so good to hear your voice. Are you okay?
No need to worry, Carla. You know I'm a big boy and can take good care of myself.

I know, but still... I haven't seen you in ages. Please come back to Thynome. I... we need you here. We've worked out a plan to reverse the supernova, and I need your feedback on some curtains I found.
Curt...? Ugh, okay, I'm on my way.
Ah Keith, there you are! I'd love for us to have some time together, but there's vital work to be done... We'll discuss the curtains later... but now, let Khador explain the plan...

Thank you, Carla. Upon following the gamma ray burst patterns, our readings suggest that what we are experiencing is indeed a phenomenon similar to what you humans would call "supernova". These have never been observed at such proximity, however, so this is purely conjecture.
This must be a very early stage example. I believe that whatever caused the imbalance in the star's integrity can be reversed before destabilizing the entire sector.

I have built a reverse matter core generator into the largest missile available to us in order to contain and shield it from instant incineration. The idea is to create, in effect, a miniature black-hole inside the star to cancel the proliferation of energy production.
I wish I had a skip button of my own...
Our current predicament is that we have had to reduce the propulsion system to a bare minimum to allow enough room for the generator.
Which means we need someone to fly in close enough to release it at close range.
Ah... Okay... I was wondering where I came into all this... You were starting to lose me there, Khador!

Your ship is equipped with the best gamma ray protection currently at our disposal. However, we need to make some improvements. By consulting these blueprints I am now making available to you, you can help us in completing the shield enhancements, so we may commence the mission forthwith.
Okay, well, there are some extra materials to get, I see. I guess if you want the job done right, I'm your man!

Ah Keith, the gamma shield is fully prepared! We should lose no more time in fulfilling our task. Your ship is being fitted with the missile as we speak. Please, try to release at the optimum proximity, or else the missile may not reach the star!
The components for the matter core generator were extremely difficult to attain. A second opportunity may not present itself to us!
Don't worry, Khador. I'll make sure the missile gets to where it needs to be.
I will be accompanying you on this mission to ensure as much, although I will remain purely in an observational capacity.
Let's just hope this doesn't turn into a running commentary.
Well, maybe we can make this the last dangerous mission? You can't expect me to sit here worrying about you while you're out all the time flying into suns!
Relax, Carla. Really, this is what I'm meant to be doing. The Midorians are depending on us right now to sort out this mess.
How exciting! I am very much enjoying the prospect of witnessing the spectacle first-hand!
This is as far as the gamma rays allow us to go. You're on your own from here!
Okay, now we just need to get near enough.
We will be privileged with a unique view of a controlled supernova implosion, and perhaps the first documented life-forms to achieve such a feat.
Yeah, well let's just see what happens first, okay? We can hypothesize about it later.
Stealth fighters! They're crazy to get in this close to the supernova! They must be intent on stopping us.
So these are the bullies who have been hampering the Midorians! Oh, have at them, Mr. Maxwell!
Okay, I hope we get there soon. My eyes are hurting from all this gazing at the sun.
Here it goes... Bombs away!
This doesn't look right at all. It seems like the supernova got even bigger!

Oh dear, this is certainly not as we planned. It appears the supernova has taken an adverse effect to the reverse matter core generator and has absorbed it as a fuel, flaming the phenomenon at an accelerated rate!
How could I have made such an obvious error? We should return to Thynome at once. I'm afraid I must face my colleagues in disgrace.
Hold on there, Khador. There's one of those stealth fighters. His radar must have been damaged by the energy burst, he doesn't seem to notice us...
A good opportunity to follow him and get to the bottom of this.

On second thoughts, maybe not...
Let's get back to Thynome, for now.
Keith, thank the Goddesses you're safe! I got such a fright!
Yeah, well that proved to be a very interesting trip on a number of levels. Khador is taking it all quite badly, I think he might need time to recover.
It seems that he has locked himself in his lab. I imagine his scientific pride has taken a massive blow.
While Khador's out of commission, do you have any other ideas for counter-measures? This could escalate the Midorian situation.

Yes, actually, we do have something. Out of desperation I consulted some data that a visiting archaeologist left behind. A certain Thadellonius Moonsprocket. It seems he was on to something. His data stick contained construction plans for a kind of plasma array for depressurizing supernovae...
Data stick... Hehe...

This plasma array is apparently capable of projecting anti-anti-matter over large distances. But the technology is from an ancient extinct race. As far as we know, only Moonsprocket can tell us more about the anti-anti-matter!
You're stuttering...
Keith, we need you to find Moonsprocket for us. He's travelling with his Bobolan psychiatrist, Brillo Lampeter, and from what he said, probably drowning his sorrows in some space lounge.

Hey, hold on here! You want me to go crawling around space lounges while all this other stuff is going on? Carla, really, I have more important things to be doing. Are you perhaps trying to keep me out of trouble?

Keith, this is important. We don't have any other good ideas at the moment. This plasma array might just work. This supernova could make the entire Midorian sector uninhabitable for millennia to come!
Alright! I get it! Why do you always have to be so melodramatic!
So you'll do it! Thank you, darling. I'd suggest you pick up the trail at the start of his latest binge, here in our space lounge, I suppose.
Yeah, well hopefully I don't run into any unpaid tabs on this mission. Sheesh.
Good luck, Keith! And try not to get too drunk!
Meanwhile in the Midorian sector...

Commander Snocom, we thank you for your enduring support through this crisis. With this new turn of events, however, our prospects appear extremely bleak. The supernova area of effect is spreading to all neighbouring systems.
Bargand Surr, we will continue to do all we can to ameliorate your current crisis. The Midorians will endure as a faction, and I extend our commitment to this end.

While encouraging to hear that we are not alone in our tribulations, I am also faced with the cold realities of our tenuous position. The powers of the galaxy seem to be in unison against us. I can only hope that our dream of a Midorian future is not shattered in this trial by fire.

I ask you to take consolation in the fact that our top scientists are working around the clock to find a new solution to the supernova threat. And we have our best man, Maxwell, assisting them at this very moment...
Yo, barkeep! What's happenin'? You seen Moonsprocket and Lampeter?
Those guys? Nah. They're personae non grata here... Made it into my red book. I'd reckon they've gone to Nepis space lounge if they're looking to get wasted.
Huh, I'll hit up Nepis in that case.
Hi, have you seen a professor type with a Bobolan sidekick knocking about this joint? Both possibly on the far side of inebriated?
Ohh, I don't know... without an infusion of bubblytastic, my memory receptors do not quite link to my synapses...
Oh, yes, I've heard of that condition! What is it you need to get the signals flowing?
A Magnetar Juice would fit the bill.
Allow me to fix you up...
There you go, one Magnetar Juice. Those receptors tingling yet?

Oh yeah! You're talking about Moonsprocket, right? We were engaged to be married but then he ran off with a rhinocitroll tamer to Plural Z from what I heard. If I ever get my hands on him I'll... What was I talking about? Without an infusion of bubblytastic, my memory receptors do not quite link to my synapses...
Hmm... on to Plural Z, then.
Have you seen a mad old professor with a slug sidekick knocking about here?
Those clowns? I had to eject them a little while ago... Hey, are you going to settle their tab?
I'm just looking for them. Where did they go?

Tell you what, I got some loan sharks out for my blood. I sent them on a wild goose chase and now they're out near Marktesh station. It won't take long until they realize they've been duped. If you help me take care of them, I'll help you. What do you say?
I suppose if you close that tab too it's a deal. I'll be back soon.
Hmm, all quiet. I'll bet they're hiding in the asteroid field, preparing to ambush the barkeeper. I should take a closer look and see if I can flush them out.
Hey, what are you doing here? You're blowing our cover!
You got it all wrong, guys. I'm the one who's hunting you!
I never did like loan sharks. Now back to the bar.
Ok, those guys you told me about have been "taken care of." Where is Moonsprocket?

Bloddy hell! You really mean business! I didn't expect you to... Moonsprocket and Lampeter took off to the Pescal Inartu system. He was on the trail of some "rare exquisite" off some dodgy trader. Okay, I'll close that tab. You're welcome back anytime mate...
Exquisite? What the heck does that mean? Anyway, don't go borrowing off dodgy traders again, eh?
Ok, I should search the lounges of Pescal Inartu. I hope I find these characters soon. I'm getting tired of all this lounge-hopping... Too much like my academy days.
Hmm, they don't seem to be here. I better check the other lounges.
Sorry, buddy, those guys left here ages ago. We still haven't gotten the stains off the walls.
This place looks too orderly to have had a visitation from our friends. I'll have to keep looking.
Old Moonie and Brillo? Yeah, they did the cabaret show in here not too long ago! Haha, they were a laugh! They were so out of their brains, I doubt they could have gotten very far...
Bzzt! Zip! Crackle! Whoooo!
Professor Moonsprocket, I presume!
Burble! Whaaa! Zoink, zoink! Pizz!
Um, something's not right here... Dr. Lampeter?
Honk honk! Yazoo! Pip pip!
Oh, boy. I better talk to the bartender and find out what these guys are on!
Maxwell!
Mkkt Bkkt! This is just getting weirder! What are you doing here?
Welcome Keith! The admins of Maissa were kind enough, or should I say bribable enough to let me set up shop here. Care for a Pescal Inartu frivolity?
It is nice to see you again, Mkkt Bkkt, but I'm here on serious business. You see these two characters?
Ah, the old professor and his shrink!
I need them sobered up and out of here fast. They're needed on a top secret mission.

Hmm, you might have a bit of a problem there, Maxwell. They're off their rockers on Flabbergasters! It will be some time until they're fit to travel anywhere or speak coherently. Come back later and try again!
That won't do! Isn't there an antidote?
Well, yes, there is something... But... Are you sure about this, Maxwell?
It requires something stupidly dangerous, doesn't it...

Of course it does! The anti-fungal extract, K'mirrk Toad Mutagen, is acidic and highly volatile. It can be purchased on Bak S'ondorr. Here are the coordinates. But you'll need to take extra special care in transporting it.
Oh well, if there's nothing else for it.... I better get going.
Hey, I heard that I can buy some K'mirrk Toad Mutagen here.
Yes, you can get it at the shop. You're not going to carry this stuff off-station, are you? A brave or foolish man you would be.
What do you mean?

Well it's not the most stable product. It has to be treated with absolute caution. You won't be able to use your booster too much or make any sudden moves or... BANG! And better stay out of trouble or...KABOOM!
Okay, useful safety tip. Thanks for the info.
I should buy the stuff at the shop, then.
I got the K'mirrk Toad Mutagen. Now back to Moonsprocket. I gotta take this real easy. Might take a while...
Meanwhile, back on Thynome station...
I hope Keith is alright. I start to get nervous when he doesn't answer the hails.
If the systematic accumulation of dark matter in the secondary orbital range is in turn assimilated into the burst pattern. Hmm, did you say something, Carla?
Since Keith and I have been living together I've been feeling more and more, like, I don't know... Like there needs to be MORE!
Ah, yes! Co-dependency in the subatomic marginal range could lead to super-absorbency in the burst pattern, reducing the likelihood of matter compatibility.
It's like my instinct tells me to keep Keith close, for us to fly off to a safe haven and start our own little moon-farm.
The mysteries of Terran instinct, primordial echoes interwoven in the genetic memory, one of my earliest studies on the Terran home planet... Although they thought they were studying me...
Oh, if we could go somewhere like that, where the air is not recycled but organically produced!
Is it photosynthesis you refer to?
We're not on the same wavelength at all, are we?
Are you speaking of ionic or phonemic wavelengths?
Gah!
Stealth fighters! Just what I need!
Okay, I've got the antidote! Let's get it into them right away!
Oh, careful with that stuff or you'll blow their heads off!
Bzzt! Crackle! Prrp! Mkkt! Fungle! Bkkt! Mkkt Bkkt! Aha! Another round, good man!
Not likely, professor... My name is Keith T. Maxwell. You have work to do back on Thynome!
Ah, the famous Keith T. Maxwell! To what do I owe the pressure?
My aching brain organs! What a rude awakening! Hair of the dog, good sir!
Come on, I have to get you two to Thynome. You'll both have to squeeze into one seat, but I'm sure you'll manage... Mkkt, we'll meet again, old pal!
We always do! Farewell old friend!
Back to Thynome, then!
Professor Moonsprocket. I am truly glad to have you back. I feel I must apologize for judging you so harshly. It seems you did have vital information for us after all.

I am humbled by your apology, which I gracefully accept. And I am happy to be back. I think that potion Maxwell administered managed to clear out the old neurotransmitters and reinvigorate the old thought processes!
Good. We'll need you in top form to explain to us what all this means...
The plasma array, yes! It's an anti-anti-matter projector!
Anti-anti-matter... Isn't that just matter?
It's not "matter", and it's not "not-matter" ... it's "not-not-matter"! Who amongst us has the scientific degree, my boy? Leave the important work to the professionals, please!
Bloody hell!
The core of the supernova is a perpetually expanding anti-matter bubble, forcing the star's expansion. We simply need to direct anti-anti-matter into that core to reverse the process.
We gathered as much from the construction plans you left. But how do we generate anti-anti-matter?

Now there's an age-old question that perplexed many an ancient empire! I was at an archaeological dig in the Paréah system some decades ago when a Nivelian colleague stumbled upon several rare antique prisms.

I now have proof that these same prisms, when arranged into the plasma array on my discovered construction plans, can concentrate effluvium from specific gas clouds found throughout the galaxy and transform it into the ultra-complex anti-anti-matter.
Makes sense.
We only need to ask for a loan of said prisms to apply the process to the plasma array construction. The last I heard from my colleague, he deposited them in the Nivelian Vaults of Névan.
That's something I can help with. I'll go and get those prisms. You all just be ready for when I'm back.
The plans for the array should all be in order, so you don't need me for that part. But Maxwell, I'd better accompany you. My credentials will surely open doors.
Agreed. But please try to avoid any stopovers at space lounges...
Not at all! I'm quite enjoying my breather after that refreshing detox!
Uh, okay... In that case, let's make this quick.
This is Homespace Security. State your destination and intent.
This is Thadellonius Moonsprocket of the Trans-Galactic Academy here to see Curator Dr. Gum'Skratch.
Thank you, professor, you are indeed passed for clearance.
Huh, so I guess our professor here is somewhat renowned!
Okay, here we are, professor.
Allow me to do the talking, Maxwell. I know the lingo!
Moonsprocket! I must say your visit is quite unexpected. Was there something in particular I could help you with?
